zstd_invalid_header.location: Results → Value viewer → Format note → Decode failure reason: reason used when a value starts with the zstd magic bytes but its frame header is corrupt or cut short; fills {error} in the “not decodable as …, showing the hex dump” warning.
zstd_invalid_header.value: encabezado de trama zstd dañado o truncado

zstd_missing_header.location: Results → Value viewer → Format note → Decode failure reason: reason used when zstd is picked but the value does not start with the zstd magic bytes 28 b5 2f fd; fills {error} in the “not decodable as …, showing the hex dump” warning.
zstd_missing_header.value: no hay encabezado de trama zstd (28 b5 2f fd)

zstd_open_failed.location: Results → Value viewer → Format note → Decode failure reason: reason used when the zstd decompressor cannot be started for the value; {error} is its technical message, prefixed with the format name “zstd”.

browse_button.location: Object Explorer → Database or schema context menu → Export Tables dialog → Footer buttons: button at the left of the footer that opens a folder picker and fills the Output folder field with the chosen folder.

cli_copied_button.location: Object Explorer → Database or schema context menu → Export Tables dialog → Footer buttons: confirmation label that replaces “Copy CLI command” after the equivalent command line was copied to the clipboard; reverts once any option changes.

cli_copy_requirements.location: Object Explorer → Database or schema context menu → Export Tables dialog: inline error shown above the table list when Copy CLI command is clicked without an output folder, a checked table, or a format the command-line tool can write.
cli_copy_requirements.value: Para copiar el comando CLI se necesita una carpeta de salida, al menos una tabla y el formato CSV, TSV, JSON, JSON Lines o Markdown

copy_cli_button.location: Object Explorer → Database or schema context menu → Export Tables dialog → Footer buttons: button that copies an equivalent sqlly command-line invocation for the current choices to the clipboard; disabled for formats the CLI cannot write.

database_scope.location: Object Explorer → Database or schema context menu → Export Tables dialog → Description line: lowercase word filling the parenthesised scope in “Export tables from … (…)” when the dialog was opened on a whole database rather than one schema.

description.location: Results → Export Tables dialog: description identifying the source {database_name} and database or schema {scope}, and explaining that each selected table is exported separately.
description.value: Exportar tablas de {database_name} ({scope}) a archivos independientes.

dialog_title.location: Object Explorer → Database or schema context menu → Export Tables dialog: dialog title; {connection_name} is the name of the saved connection whose tables are listed for batch export to separate files.

filename_pattern_hint.location: Object Explorer → Database or schema context menu → Export Tables dialog → Filename pattern: small caption above the filename pattern input listing the tokens in double braces; {default_pattern} is the pattern used when the field is empty.
filename_pattern_hint.value: Patrón de nombre de archivo — tokens: {{schema}}, {{table}}, {{date}}, {{format}} (predeterminado: {default_pattern})

folder_required.location: Object Explorer → Database or schema context menu → Export Tables dialog: inline error shown above the table list when the export button is clicked while the Output folder field is empty.

format_label.location: Object Explorer → Database or schema context menu → Export Tables dialog → Format: small caption above the export file-format dropdown (CSV, JSON, Excel, …); its English text currently repeats the filename-pattern hint by mistake; it should name the format choice.

formula_protection.location: Object Explorer → Database or schema context menu → Export Tables dialog → Options: checkbox label; when checked, cell values starting with =, +, - or @ are prefixed with an apostrophe so spreadsheets do not run them as formulas.
formula_protection.value: Proteger contra fórmulas de hojas de cálculo (prefijo =, +, -, @ con apóstrofe)

gzip_files.location: Object Explorer → Database or schema context menu → Export Tables dialog → Options: checkbox label; when checked, each exported table file is written gzip-compressed.

include_header.location: Object Explorer → Database or schema context menu → Export Tables dialog → Options: checkbox label; when checked, each exported file starts with a row of column names.

line_breaks_escape.location: Object Explorer → Database or schema context menu → Export Tables dialog → Line breaks in cells dropdown: third option; writes line breaks inside cell values as escape sequences instead of real line breaks.

line_breaks_keep.location: Object Explorer → Database or schema context menu → Export Tables dialog → Line breaks in cells dropdown: first (default) option; leaves line breaks inside cell values unchanged in the exported files.

line_breaks_label.location: Object Explorer → Database or schema context menu → Export Tables dialog → Line breaks in cells: small caption above the dropdown choosing how line breaks inside cell values are written (keep, replace with space, escape).

line_breaks_space.location: Object Explorer → Database or schema context menu → Export Tables dialog → Line breaks in cells dropdown: second option; replaces each line break inside a cell value with a single space.

loading_tables.location: Object Explorer → Database or schema context menu → Export Tables dialog → Table list: placeholder shown in place of the table checkboxes while the dialog is still fetching the database’s tables.

no_tables.location: Object Explorer → Database or schema context menu → Export Tables dialog → Table list: empty-state message shown when the database or schema has no tables to export and no loading error occurred.

null_custom.location: Object Explorer → Database or schema context menu → Export Tables dialog → NULL text dropdown: last option; shows a text field where the user types their own text to write for NULL values.

null_empty.location: Object Explorer → Database or schema context menu → Export Tables dialog → NULL text dropdown: second option; writes NULL values as an empty cell.

null_format_default.location: Object Explorer → Database or schema context menu → Export Tables dialog → NULL text dropdown: first (default) option; uses whatever NULL representation the chosen file format normally uses.

null_text_label.location: Object Explorer → Database or schema context menu → Export Tables dialog → NULL text: small caption above the dropdown choosing what text represents NULL values in the exported files.

output_folder_label.location: Object Explorer → Database or schema context menu → Export Tables dialog → Output folder: small caption above the folder path input where the exported files are written (filled by Browse… or typed).

run_button.location: Object Explorer → Database or schema context menu → Export Tables dialog → Footer buttons: primary button that starts the export; plural form, {table_count} is the number of checked tables (0 or 2 and more).

run_button_one.location: Object Explorer → Database or schema context menu → Export Tables dialog → Footer buttons: primary button that starts the export; singular form used when exactly one table is checked ({table_count} is 1).

schema_scope.location: Object Explorer → Database or schema context menu → Export Tables dialog → Description line: lowercase phrase filling the parenthesised scope in “Export tables from … (…)” when opened on one schema; {schema_name} is that schema.

select_all_button.location: Object Explorer → Database or schema context menu → Export Tables dialog → Footer buttons: left-side button that checks every table in the list.

select_none_button.location: Object Explorer → Database or schema context menu → Export Tables dialog → Footer buttons: left-side button that unchecks every table in the list.

table_required.location: Object Explorer → Database or schema context menu → Export Tables dialog: inline error shown above the table list when the export button is clicked with no table checked.

always_mask_button.location: Results → Toolbar → Mask suggestion chips: second chip, shown when the AI decision model flags personal-looking columns; adds those columns to the global masking rules so they are masked in every result.
always_mask_button.value: Enmascarar siempre estas columnas: añadirlas a las reglas de enmascaramiento globales

always_mask_tooltip.location: Results → Toolbar → Mask suggestion chips: tooltip on the “Always mask” chip explaining that it adds the suggested columns to the global masking rules (Settings → Results → Masking).
always_mask_tooltip.value: Enmascarar siempre estas columnas: añadirlas a las reglas de enmascaramiento globales

dismiss_mask_suggestion_tooltip.location: Results → Toolbar → Mask suggestion chips: tooltip on the small × chip after the mask suggestion; hides the suggestion for the current result only.
dismiss_mask_suggestion_tooltip.value: Descartar esta sugerencia para este resultado.

mask_many_personal_columns.location: Results → Toolbar → Mask suggestion chips: chip label asking whether to mask columns the AI decision model thinks hold personal data; plural form, {column_count} is 2 or more.
mask_many_personal_columns.value: ¿Enmascarar {column_count} columnas que parecen contener datos personales?

mask_one_personal_column.location: Results → Toolbar → Mask suggestion chips: chip label asking whether to mask the single column the AI decision model thinks holds personal data; singular form.
mask_one_personal_column.value: ¿Enmascarar {column_count} columna que parece contener datos personales?

mask_suggestion_tooltip.location: Results → Toolbar → Mask suggestion chips: tooltip on the “Mask N personal-looking columns?” chip; clicking masks those columns in the current result only.
mask_suggestion_tooltip.value: Columnas cuyos valores parecen personales: haz clic para enmascararlas en este resultado

masked_columns_tooltip.location: Results → Toolbar: tooltip on the shield icon chip shown while some result columns are masked; clicking reveals all masked values in the current result.
masked_columns_tooltip.value: Columnas enmascaradas: haz clic para mostrarlas todas en este resultado

multi_sort_tooltip.location: Results → Toolbar: tooltip on the chip listing the sort columns, shown when the grid is sorted by two or more columns; clicking removes the sort.
multi_sort_tooltip.value: Ordenación por varias columnas: haz clic para quitarla

save_chart_library.location: Results → Toolbar: chip shown while the Chart tab is in front; opens the flow that saves this chart with its query to the Saved Charts library.

save_chart_library_tooltip.location: Results → Toolbar: tooltip on the “Save chart to library…” chip explaining that the chart layout and query are kept in Tools → Saved Charts and on the Chart Dashboard.
save_chart_library_tooltip.value: Guarda este diseño de gráfico con su consulta en Herramientas > Gráficos guardados y en el Panel de gráficos

suggested_chart_revert.location: Results → Toolbar: chip shown while the Chart tab displays a layout chosen by the AI decision model; clicking reverts to the chart’s automatic detection. Short label, “·” separates two parts.

suggested_chart_tooltip.location: Results → Toolbar: tooltip on the “Suggested chart · Revert” chip explaining that the AI decision model picked the chart layout and clicking restores automatic detection.
suggested_chart_tooltip.value: Este diseño de gráfico fue sugerido por el modelo de decisión; haz clic para volver a la detección automática.

complete_footer.location: Results → Grid context menu → Values → Top Values window: summary line at the top of the window after every row was counted; {counted_rows} is the number of rows counted. Clicking a listed value filters the grid column.
complete_footer.value: {counted_rows} filas contadas. Haz clic en un valor para filtrar esta columna.

counting_footer.location: Results → Grid context menu → Values → Top Values window: progress line at the top of the window while a large on-disk result is still being read; {row_count} is how many rows will be read.

empty_values.location: Results → Grid context menu → Values → Top Values window: empty-state message in the value list when the counted rows contain no values for this column.
empty_values.value: No hay valores en las filas contadas.

read_error.location: Results → Grid context menu → Values → Top Values window: error line at the top of the window when the result’s temporary on-disk copy (spill file) could not be read while counting.
read_error.value: No se pudo leer el archivo de volcado del resultado; cierra esta ventana e inténtalo de nuevo.

sampled_footer.location: Results → Grid context menu → Values → Top Values window: summary line at the top when only part of the rows were counted; {counted_rows} rows counted out of {total_rows} in the column. Clicking a value filters the grid column.
sampled_footer.value: Se contaron las primeras {counted_rows} de {total_rows} filas: los recuentos corresponden solo a esas filas. Haz clic en un valor para filtrar esta columna por él.

stale_results.location: Results → Grid context menu → Values → Top Values window: message at the top of the window when the grid’s results were replaced (for example by re-running the query) while the window was open.
stale_results.value: Estos resultados fueron reemplazados: cierra esta ventana y vuelve a abrir Valores principales.

value_count.location: Results → Grid context menu → Values → Top Values window: occurrence count shown at the right of each value row; {count} is how many times the value appears. Keep it very short (× means “times”).

window_title.location: Results → Grid context menu → Values → Top Values window: title of the small separate window listing a column’s most frequent values; {column_name} is the grid column it counts.

complete_caption.location: Results → Grid context menu → Tools → Transpose: caption above the grid while the result is shown transposed; {row_count} is the number of original rows now shown as columns.

reading_rows.location: Results → Grid context menu → Tools → Transpose: caption above the grid while a large on-disk result is read before transposing; {row_count} is the number of rows being read.

source_column_header.location: Results → Grid context menu → Tools → Transpose: header of the first column in the transposed grid, which lists the original column names.

source_row_header.location: Results → Grid context menu → Tools → Transpose: header of each data column in the transposed grid; {row_number} is the 1-based number of the original row it shows.

truncated_caption.location: Results → Grid context menu → Tools → Transpose: caption above the grid when the result had more than 1,000 rows and only the first 1,000 were transposed; {row_count} is the number transposed.
truncated_caption.value: Transpuesto — {row_count} filas como columnas — se muestran las primeras 1.000 filas

error_disabled_or_renamed.location: Administration → Activity Monitor → Redis Slow Log: inline error shown when Redis does not recognize CONFIG; preserve the raw server detail.
error_disabled_or_renamed.value: CONFIG está desactivado o tiene otro nombre en este servidor: {detail}

error_failed.location: Administration → Activity Monitor → Redis Slow Log: generic inline error shown when reading the threshold fails; preserve the raw detail.

error_permission.location: Administration → Activity Monitor → Redis Slow Log: inline error shown when the Redis ACL refuses CONFIG GET; preserve the raw server detail.
error_permission.value: este usuario no tiene permiso para ejecutar CONFIG GET (+config|get): {detail}

lead_disabled.location: Administration → Activity Monitor → Redis Slow Log: leading status shown when the slow-log threshold is negative.

lead_threshold.location: Administration → Activity Monitor → Redis Slow Log: leading status showing the configured slow-log threshold with units.

lead_unknown.location: Administration → Activity Monitor → Redis Slow Log: leading status shown when the threshold cannot be read.

note_disabled.location: Administration → Activity Monitor → Redis Slow Log: caption explaining that logging is disabled and older retained commands are shown.
note_disabled.value: el registro lento está desactivado (slowlog-log-slower-than = {threshold_micros}); se muestran hasta los {command_limit} comandos más recientes registrados anteriormente

note_threshold.location: Administration → Activity Monitor → Redis Slow Log: caption describing the command limit and active threshold.
note_threshold.value: mostrando los {command_limit} comandos más recientes más lentos que {threshold}

note_unknown.location: Administration → Activity Monitor → Redis Slow Log: caption shown when commands are available but their threshold is unknown.
note_unknown.value: mostrando los {command_limit} comandos más recientes del registro lento (no se pudo leer el umbral slowlog-log-slower-than)

no_key_original_values.location: Administration → Transaction Preview → Primary Key Warning: warning shown when updates must use original values for conflict detection.
no_key_original_values.value: No se detectó una clave primaria; las actualizaciones generadas usan predicados de conflicto con los valores originales.

no_key_read_only.location: Administration → Table Editing → Primary Key Warning: warning shown when no stable key permits editing.
no_key_read_only.value: La edición sin clave primaria es de solo lectura hasta que se seleccione una clave estable.

backup_failed.location: Administration → Backup: error shown when a database backup fails; preserve the raw server detail.
backup_failed.value: Error al crear la copia de seguridad: {detail}

not_supported.location: Administration tools → Capability error: message shown when the selected administrative operation is unsupported.

restore_failed.location: Administration → Restore: error shown when a database restore fails; preserve the raw server detail.

rank_avg_duration.location: Administration → Query Insights: ranking option that sorts queries by average execution duration.

rank_avg_reads.location: Administration → Query Insights: ranking option that sorts queries by average read activity.

rank_executions.location: Administration → Query Insights: ranking option that sorts queries by execution count.

action_failed.location: SQL Agent → Job Action Error: message shown when a job action fails; preserve the server detail.

job_not_found.location: SQL Agent → Job Error: message shown when the requested job no longer exists.

not_available.location: SQL Agent → Availability Error: message shown when the agent cannot be used; preserve the server detail.

agent_starts.location: SQL Agent → Schedules: recurrence text for a schedule triggered by agent startup.
agent_starts.value: Cuando se inicia el Agente SQL Server

computer_idle.location: SQL Agent → Schedules: recurrence text for a schedule triggered by computer idle time.

daily.location: SQL Agent → Schedules: recurrence text for a daily schedule.

every_days.location: SQL Agent → Schedules: recurrence text for a schedule repeating every several days.

monthly_day.location: SQL Agent → Schedules: recurrence text for a monthly day-of-month schedule.

monthly_relative.location: SQL Agent → Schedules: recurrence text for a relative monthly schedule.

once.location: SQL Agent → Schedules: recurrence text for a one-time schedule.

unknown.location: SQL Agent → Schedules: honest fallback showing raw frequency codes for an unknown recurrence.

friday.location: SQL Agent → Schedules: abbreviated Friday name in a weekly recurrence.

monday.location: SQL Agent → Schedules: abbreviated Monday name in a weekly recurrence.

saturday.location: SQL Agent → Schedules: abbreviated Saturday name in a weekly recurrence.

sunday.location: SQL Agent → Schedules: abbreviated Sunday name in a weekly recurrence.

thursday.location: SQL Agent → Schedules: abbreviated Thursday name in a weekly recurrence.

tuesday.location: SQL Agent → Schedules: abbreviated Tuesday name in a weekly recurrence.

wednesday.location: SQL Agent → Schedules: abbreviated Wednesday name in a weekly recurrence.

weekly.location: SQL Agent → Schedules: recurrence text for a weekly schedule without named weekdays.

weekly_days.location: SQL Agent → Schedules: recurrence text for a weekly schedule with separately localized weekdays.

egress_claude.location: AI → Local Agent → Privacy Notice: disclosure shown before enabling Claude Code agent mode.
egress_claude.value: El modo agente ejecuta una CLI local de Claude Code que se comunica con la nube de Anthropic; los nombres de tablas, listas de columnas, filas de ejemplo y resultados SELECT pasan a través de ella.

egress_codex.location: AI → Local Agent → Privacy Notice: disclosure shown before enabling Codex agent mode.
egress_codex.value: El modo agente ejecuta una CLI local de Codex que se comunica con la nube de OpenAI; los nombres de tablas, listas de columnas, filas de ejemplo y resultados SELECT pasan a través de ella.

corrupt.location: AI → Schema Catalog → Storage Error: message shown when the local catalog is corrupt; preserve the integrity-check detail.
corrupt.value: el archivo de catálogo no superó la comprobación de integridad: {detail}

newer_schema.location: AI → Schema Catalog → Compatibility Error: message shown when the catalog schema is newer than the app supports.
newer_schema.value: el catálogo fue creado por una aplicación más reciente (generación de esquema {stamped}, esta compilación admite {supported}); actualiza la aplicación

decode.location: AI → Decision Provider → Decode Error: message shown when the provider response cannot be decoded.
decode.value: no se pudo decodificar la respuesta del proveedor de decisiones: {detail}

disabled.location: AI → Decision Provider → Availability Error: message shown when the decision provider is disabled.
disabled.value: el proveedor de decisiones está desactivado

invalid_request.location: AI → Decision Provider → Request Error: message shown when a decision request is invalid.

rate_limited.location: AI → Decision Provider → Rate Limit Error: message shown after the provider rate limits a request.
rate_limited.value: el proveedor de decisiones limitó la solicitud

status.location: AI → Decision Provider → HTTP Error: message shown for an unsuccessful provider response; preserve the response detail.
status.value: el proveedor de decisiones devolvió HTTP {status}: {detail}

transport.location: AI → Decision Provider → Transport Error: message shown when the provider cannot be reached; preserve the detail.
transport.value: error de transporte del proveedor de decisiones: {detail}

dimension_mismatch.location: AI → Embeddings → Model Error: message shown when a model returns an unexpected embedding dimension.
dimension_mismatch.value: dimensión de incrustación incorrecta: el modelo {model} esperaba {expected} dimensiones, pero recibió {actual}

build.location: AI → Jev Provider → Client Error: message shown when the HTTP client cannot be constructed.
build.value: no se pudo crear el cliente HTTP de Jev: {detail}

decode.location: AI → Jev Provider → Decode Error: message shown when the Jev response cannot be decoded.
decode.value: no se pudo decodificar la respuesta de Jev: {detail}

rate_limited.location: AI → Jev Provider → Rate Limit Error: message shown after Jev rate limits a request.

status.location: AI → Jev Provider → HTTP Error: message shown for an unsuccessful Jev response; preserve the response detail.

transport.location: AI → Jev Provider → Transport Error: message shown when the Jev endpoint cannot be reached.
transport.value: no se pudo contactar con Jev en {url} ({detail})

build.location: AI → MLX Provider → Client Error: message shown when the sidecar HTTP client cannot be constructed.
build.value: no se pudo crear el cliente HTTP de MLX: {detail}

decode.location: AI → MLX Provider → Decode Error: message shown when the sidecar response cannot be decoded.
decode.value: no se pudo decodificar la respuesta del sidecar MLX de {url}: {detail}

dimension_mismatch.location: AI → MLX Provider → Embedding Error: message shown when the model's embedding dimension differs from the stored dimension.
dimension_mismatch.value: dimensión de incrustación incorrecta para el modelo '{model}': se esperaban {expected}, pero se obtuvieron {actual}

empty.location: AI → MLX Provider → Response Error: message shown when the sidecar returns no required content.
empty.value: El sidecar MLX devolvió un resultado vacío: {detail}

model_not_found.location: AI → MLX Provider → Model Error: message shown when the sidecar does not have the requested model.
model_not_found.value: modelo '{model}' no encontrado en el sidecar MLX

status.location: AI → MLX Provider → HTTP Error: message shown for an unsuccessful sidecar response; preserve the response detail.
status.value: El sidecar MLX devolvió HTTP {status} para {url}: {detail}

transport.location: AI → MLX Provider → Transport Error: guidance shown when the local MLX sidecar cannot be reached.
transport.value: no se pudo contactar con el sidecar MLX en {url} ({detail}); ¿está en ejecución?

unsupported_capability.location: AI → MLX Provider → Capability Error: message shown when a model lacks the requested capability.
unsupported_capability.value: el modelo '{model}' no admite la funcionalidad {capability}

build.location: AI → Ollama Provider → Client Error: message shown when the HTTP client cannot be constructed.
build.value: no se pudo crear el cliente HTTP de Ollama: {detail}

decode.location: AI → Ollama Provider → Decode Error: message shown when the Ollama response cannot be decoded.
decode.value: no se pudo decodificar la respuesta de Ollama de {url}: {detail}

empty.location: AI → Ollama Provider → Response Error: message shown when Ollama returns no required content.

status.location: AI → Ollama Provider → HTTP Error: message shown for an unsuccessful Ollama response; preserve the response detail.

transport.location: AI → Ollama Provider → Transport Error: guidance shown when the local Ollama runtime cannot be reached.
transport.value: no se pudo contactar con Ollama en {url} ({detail}); ¿se está ejecutando el entorno local de Ollama?

storage.location: AI → Vector Store → Storage Error: message shown when vector storage fails; preserve the storage detail.
storage.value: error de almacenamiento del almacén de vectores: {detail}

clickhouse_view_unsupported.location: View Editor → Description Field → ClickHouse Availability: guidance shown when a ClickHouse view description cannot be altered.
clickhouse_view_unsupported.value: ClickHouse no admite ALTER … COMMENT en vistas; vuelve a crear la vista con una cláusula COMMENT

cockroach_view_unsupported.location: View Editor → Description Field → CockroachDB Availability: reason shown when view descriptions are unsupported.
cockroach_view_unsupported.value: CockroachDB no admite COMMENT ON VIEW; no se pueden almacenar descripciones de vistas

engine_unsupported.location: Structure Editor → Description Field → Engine Availability: generic reason shown when descriptions are unsupported for the connection engine.
engine_unsupported.value: Las descripciones de objetos no son compatibles con conexiones de {engine_name}

mysql_column_not_found.location: Structure Editor → MySQL Column Description → Scripting Error: message shown when the original definition does not contain the edited column.
mysql_column_not_found.value: No se encontró la columna {column_name} en la definición de la tabla; no se generó el script del cambio de descripción.

mysql_definition_unreadable.location: Structure Editor → MySQL Column Description → Scripting Error: message preventing a description edit when the original table definition is unavailable.
mysql_definition_unreadable.value: Columna {column_name}: no se pudo leer la definición de la tabla, por lo que el cambio de descripción podría eliminar atributos de la columna. Establécela con ALTER TABLE … MODIFY COLUMN … COMMENT '…'.

mysql_view_unsupported.location: View Editor → Description Field → MySQL Availability: reason shown when a MySQL-family view cannot store a custom description.
mysql_view_unsupported.value: {engine_name} no puede almacenar una descripción en una vista (su comentario siempre es 'VIEW')

no_server_comments.location: Structure Editor → Description Field → Engine Availability: reason shown when the engine has no server-side description store.
no_server_comments.value: {engine_name} no tiene comentarios en el servidor

redis_unsupported.location: Structure Editor → Description Field → Redis Availability: reason shown when object descriptions are unavailable on Redis.
redis_unsupported.value: Redis es un almacén de clave-valor sin comentarios de objetos

descriptions_unreadable.location: Structure Editor → Description changes: error preventing edits when current server descriptions could not be loaded; preserve the raw detail.
descriptions_unreadable.value: No se pudieron leer las descripciones actuales ({detail}); vuelve a abrir el editor antes de cambiarlas.

unsupported_engine.location: Structure Editor → Engine capability error: message shown when table structure editing is unavailable for the connected engine.
unsupported_engine.value: El editor de estructura aún no es compatible con este motor

data_compare_preview.location: Browser Preview → Data Compare: unavailable-capability message directing the user to the desktop app.
data_compare_preview.value: La comparación de datos no está disponible en la vista previa del navegador; usa la aplicación de escritorio

data_compare_served.location: Hosted Browser Session → Data Compare: unavailable-capability message without a desktop-app recommendation.
data_compare_served.value: La comparación de datos no está disponible cuando SQLLY se ejecuta en un navegador

demo_object_metadata_preview.location: Browser Preview → Demo Schema Metadata: message shown when object metadata is unavailable for the demo backend.
demo_object_metadata_preview.value: Los metadatos de objetos de la base de datos de demostración no están disponibles en la vista previa del navegador; usa la aplicación de escritorio

demo_object_metadata_served.location: Hosted Browser Session → Demo Schema Metadata: message shown when object metadata is unavailable for the demo backend.
demo_object_metadata_served.value: Los metadatos de objetos de la base de datos de demostración no están disponibles cuando SQLLY se ejecuta en un navegador

foreign_key_labels_preview.location: Browser Preview → Row Editor → Foreign Key Labels: unavailable-capability message for related display labels.
foreign_key_labels_preview.value: Las etiquetas de claves foráneas no están disponibles en la vista previa del navegador; usa la aplicación de escritorio

foreign_key_labels_served.location: Hosted Browser Session → Row Editor → Foreign Key Labels: unavailable-capability message for related display labels.
foreign_key_labels_served.value: Las etiquetas de claves foráneas no están disponibles cuando SQLLY se ejecuta en un navegador

foreign_key_search_preview.location: Browser Preview → Row Editor → Foreign Key Search: unavailable-capability message for foreign-key value lookup.
foreign_key_search_preview.value: La búsqueda de claves foráneas no está disponible en la vista previa del navegador; usa la aplicación de escritorio

foreign_key_search_served.location: Hosted Browser Session → Row Editor → Foreign Key Search: unavailable-capability message for foreign-key value lookup.
foreign_key_search_served.value: La búsqueda de claves foráneas no está disponible cuando SQLLY se ejecuta en un navegador

related_row_browsing_preview.location: Browser Preview → Related Rows: unavailable-capability message directing the user to the desktop app.
related_row_browsing_preview.value: La exploración de filas relacionadas no está disponible en la vista previa del navegador; usa la aplicación de escritorio

related_row_browsing_served.location: Hosted Browser Session → Related Rows: unavailable-capability message without a desktop-app recommendation.
related_row_browsing_served.value: La exploración de filas relacionadas no está disponible cuando SQLLY se ejecuta en un navegador

row_editing_preview.location: Browser Preview → Row Editor: unavailable-capability message directing the user to the desktop app.
row_editing_preview.value: La edición de filas no está disponible en la vista previa del navegador; usa la aplicación de escritorio

row_editing_served.location: Hosted Browser Session → Row Editor: unavailable-capability message without a desktop-app recommendation.
row_editing_served.value: La edición de filas no está disponible cuando SQLLY se ejecuta en un navegador

aws_signing.location: Cloud IAM connection → AWS token error: message shown when request signing fails; preserve the provider detail.

out_of_order_left.value: La fila {row_number} del lado izquierdo no está ordenada por clave

out_of_order_right.location: Data Compare → Key Ordering Error: message shown when right rows are not sorted by the comparison key.
out_of_order_right.value: La fila {row_number} del lado derecho no está ordenada por clave

differences.location: Data Compare → Truncation Notice: message shown when the retained-difference limit stops comparison.
differences.value: Se detuvo después de {difference_count} diferencias; limita la comparación con una consulta o una cláusula WHERE.

rows_left.location: Data Compare → Truncation Notice: message shown when the left-side row limit stops comparison.
rows_left.value: Se detuvo después de {row_count} filas en el lado izquierdo; limita la comparación con una consulta o una cláusula WHERE.

rows_right.location: Data Compare → Truncation Notice: message shown when the right-side row limit stops comparison.
rows_right.value: Se detuvo después de {row_count} filas en el lado derecho; limita la comparación con una consulta o una cláusula WHERE.

empty_name.location: Database Workflow → Database Name: validation message shown when the name is empty or invalid.
empty_name.value: Introduce un nombre de base de datos

invalid_option.location: Database Workflow → Options: validation message shown when a database option contains unsupported characters.

unsupported.location: Database Workflow → Create Database: capability guidance shown instead of CREATE DATABASE for file-based SQLite.
unsupported.value: Las bases de datos SQLite son archivos: crea una desde Nueva conexión

connect_url.location: Open Link → Confirmation: description shown when SQLLY is started with a raw connection URL (such as mysql://user@server:3306/db); {engine_name} is the database engine (MySQL, PostgreSQL, …), {server_name} the user, host, port and database from the URL (never the password).

connection_url.location: Open Link → Connection String Error: wrapper shown when the embedded connection string is invalid; preserve the parser detail.

control_characters.location: Open Link → Validation Error: message shown when a deep-link parameter contains control characters.

missing_parameter.location: Open Link → Validation Error: message shown when a required deep-link parameter is absent.

not_database_file.location: Open Database File → Validation Error: message shown for an unsupported local file type.
not_database_file.value: no es un archivo de base de datos SQLite o DuckDB

not_sqlly.location: Open Link → Validation Error: message shown when input is not a SQLLY deep link.

too_long.location: Open Link → Validation Error: message shown when a deep-link parameter exceeds its size limit.

unknown_action.location: Open Link → Validation Error: message shown for an unsupported deep-link action.

unknown_parameter.location: Open Link → Validation Error: message shown for an unsupported deep-link parameter.

new_connection.location: Open Link → Confirmation: description for opening a prefilled new-connection editor.
new_connection.value: Abrir el editor de conexiones con una nueva conexión de {engine_name}

open_connection.location: Open Link → Confirmation: description for opening a saved connection without a specific object.

open_connection_database.location: Open Link → Confirmation: description for opening a saved connection and selecting a database.

open_database_engine.location: Open Database File → Confirmation: fallback description for a database file without a filename.

open_database_file.location: Open Database File → Confirmation: description for opening a named local database file.

open_object.location: Open Link → Confirmation: description for opening a qualified object on a saved connection.

open_object_database.location: Open Link → Confirmation: description for opening a qualified object and selecting a database.

open_query.location: Open Link → Confirmation: description for opening a query tab on a saved connection.

open_query_database.location: Open Link → Confirmation: description for opening a query tab and selecting a database.
open_query_database.value: Abrir una consulta en "{connection_name}" (base de datos {database_name})

open_table.location: Open Link → Confirmation: description for opening an unqualified table on a saved connection.

open_table_database.location: Open Link → Confirmation: description for opening an unqualified table and selecting a database.
open_table_database.value: Abrir la tabla {table_name} en "{connection_name}" (base de datos {database_name})

kind_function.location: Deploy Cart → Object Row: object-kind label for a function.

kind_procedure.location: Deploy Cart → Object Row: object-kind label for a stored procedure.

kind_table.location: Deploy Cart → Object Row: object-kind label for a table.

kind_view.location: Deploy Cart → Object Row: object-kind label for a view.

extensions_disabled.location: DuckDB → Extension Policy Error: explanation shown when installing or loading an extension is forbidden.
extensions_disabled.value: Instalar o cargar extensiones de DuckDB no está disponible en este motor de SQLLY: las aplicaciones de App Store no pueden descargar código y un motor que sirve navegadores a través de un proxy tampoco puede obtener código. Las funciones integradas de DuckDB siguen funcionando.

columns_unavailable.location: Database Dump → Column Export Warnings: warning shown when a table's columns cannot be read; preserve the catalog detail.

definition_unavailable.location: Database Dump → Export Warnings: warning shown when an object's definition cannot be exported; preserve the fetch detail.

foreign_keys_unavailable.location: Database Dump → Export Warnings: warning shown when foreign keys cannot guide table data ordering.
foreign_keys_unavailable.value: Claves foráneas no disponibles; el orden de los datos de las tablas puede no respetar las dependencias

sequence_defaults_unavailable.location: Database Dump → Sequence Export Warnings: warning shown when sequence-backed defaults cannot be read; preserve the catalog detail.
sequence_defaults_unavailable.value: Valores predeterminados de secuencia no disponibles: {detail}

table_data_failed.location: Database Dump → Data Export Warnings: warning shown when a table's rows cannot be read; preserve the query detail.

trigger_order_unavailable.location: Database Dump → Trigger Export Warnings: warning shown when trigger firing order cannot be read; preserve the catalog detail.
trigger_order_unavailable.value: Orden de activación de desencadenadores no disponible; los desencadenadores se escriben por nombre: {detail}

active.location: SQLly Embedded → License Status: notice shown when the bridge license is active.
active.value: La licencia de SQLly Embedded está activa.

domain_mismatch.location: SQLly Embedded → License Status: notice shown when the bridge domain differs from the licensed domain.
domain_mismatch.value: Este puente está configurado para un dominio al que no está vinculada su licencia de SQLly Embedded.

expired.location: SQLly Embedded → License Status: renewal guidance shown after the license and grace period expire.
expired.value: La licencia de SQLly Embedded de este sitio ha caducado. Pide al administrador que la renueve.

grace.location: SQLly Embedded → License Status: renewal guidance shown during the license grace period.
grace.value: La licencia de SQLly Embedded de este sitio caduca pronto. Pide al administrador que la renueve.

not_admitted.location: SQLly Embedded → License Status: notice shown when another bridge occupies the licensed instance slot.
not_admitted.value: Otro puente ocupa el espacio de instancia de esta licencia de SQLly Embedded.

revoked.location: SQLly Embedded → License Status: notice shown when the license key has been revoked.
revoked.value: La clave de licencia de SQLly Embedded ya no es válida.

stale.location: SQLly Embedded → License Status: administrator guidance shown when license confirmation has been unavailable for 40 minutes.
stale.value: SQLly Embedded no ha podido confirmar su licencia con sqlly.app durante 40 minutos; pide al administrador que la compruebe.

unlicensed.location: SQLly Embedded → License Status: administrator guidance shown before the bridge is linked to a license.
unlicensed.value: SQLly Embedded aún no está vinculado a una licencia. Pide al administrador que lo conecte a sqlly.app.

authentication.location: Sign-in and connection authentication → Error presentation: wrapper shown when authentication fails; preserve the raw diagnostic detail.

capability_not_supported.location: Engine-aware actions → Capability error: wrapper shown when the connected server cannot perform the requested operation.

connection.location: Connection operations → Error presentation: wrapper shown when a server connection fails; preserve the raw diagnostic detail.

connection_hostname_not_found.location: Connection Editor → DNS Error: message shown when the entered server hostname cannot be resolved; preserve the user-supplied hostname.
connection_hostname_not_found.value: Error de conexión: no pudimos encontrar el nombre de host "{hostname}". Asegúrate de haberlo escrito correctamente.

ssh_challenge_too_many_rounds.location: Connection error → SSH tunnel: message shown when the SSH server kept asking for more answers and SQLLY gave up; {host} and {port} are the SSH server and {count} is the number of rounds.
ssh_challenge_too_many_rounds.value: El servidor SSH {host}:{port} siguió pidiendo más respuestas, así que SQLLY se detuvo tras {count} rondas.

ssh_challenge_unavailable.location: Connection error → SSH tunnel: message shown by the command-line tool or bridge when the SSH server asks for a one-time code that can only be typed in the desktop app; {host} and {port} are the SSH server.
ssh_challenge_unavailable.value: El servidor SSH {host}:{port} pide un código de verificación, que solo se puede introducir en la aplicación de escritorio de SQLLY.

ssh_challenge_cancelled.location: Connection error → SSH tunnel: message shown when the user cancelled the SSH verification dialog, so the connection was not opened; {host} and {port} are the SSH server.
ssh_challenge_cancelled.value: Se canceló el inicio de sesión SSH en {host}:{port}.

ssh_challenge_rejected.location: Connection error → SSH tunnel: message shown when the SSH server refused the one-time code or other answer the user typed; {host} and {port} are the SSH server.
ssh_challenge_rejected.value: El servidor SSH {host}:{port} no aceptó el código de verificación. Revisa el código y vuelve a conectar.

sql_server_legacy_tls.location: Connection Editor → Test Connection / connect error for SQL Server: message shown when the server only offers TLS 1.0 or 1.1 and SQLLY refuses to connect; {server} is the server name the user entered. Keep TLS version numbers, product names and the Encrypt option name as they are.
sql_server_legacy_tls.value: Error de conexión: {server} solo ofrece TLS 1.0 o 1.1, y SQLLY requiere TLS 1.2 o posterior. Instala la actualización de TLS 1.2 para el servidor (Microsoft publica una para SQL Server 2008 R2, 2012 y 2014) o actualiza SQL Server. Desactivar Encrypt no ayuda: SQL Server sigue usando TLS para proteger el inicio de sesión.

connection_macos_local_network.location: Connection Error → macOS Local Network: guidance appended when macOS reports no route to a local-network host; preserve the raw socket detail.
connection_macos_local_network.value: Error de conexión: {detail}. Es posible que macOS esté impidiendo que SQLLY acceda a tu red local. Permite SQLLY en Ajustes del Sistema → Privacidad y seguridad → Red local e inténtalo de nuevo.

invalid_input.location: Service operations → Validation error: wrapper shown when supplied input is invalid; preserve the specific detail.

invalid_profile.location: Connection editor and profile loading → Validation error: wrapper shown when connection settings are invalid.

io.location: File and operating-system operations → Error presentation: wrapper shown when local input or output fails; preserve the raw OS detail.

object_not_found.location: Schema and object operations → Error presentation: message shown when the requested database object no longer exists.

permission_denied.location: Database operations → Permission error: wrapper shown when the server or policy refuses an operation; preserve the raw detail.

query_cancelled.location: Query execution → Cancellation error: message shown after the user cancels a running query.

query_execution.location: Query execution → Error presentation: wrapper shown when the database rejects or fails a query; preserve the raw server detail.

query_timeout.location: Query execution → Timeout error: message shown when a query exceeds its time limit, including the duration.
query_timeout.value: La consulta superó el tiempo límite después de {duration}

serialization.location: Data import, export, and protocol boundaries → Error presentation: wrapper shown when data cannot be serialized or decoded.

unsupported_capability.location: Feature actions → Capability error: message shown when the requested capability is not implemented, naming the capability.

no_host.location: Connection Editor → libSQL URL: validation error shown when the URL omits the server host.
no_host.value: La URL de libSQL no tiene host

no_tables.location: Maintenance → Empty Database: message shown when a per-table operation has no targets.
no_tables.value: La base de datos no tiene tablas en las que ejecutarla

unsupported.location: Maintenance → Capability Error: message shown when the selected engine cannot perform the operation.
unsupported.value: Esta operación de mantenimiento no está disponible en este motor

checkdb.location: Maintenance → DBCC CHECKDB Confirmation: warning about full-database reads and I/O cost.
checkdb.value: Lee toda la base de datos y puede tardar mucho; consume mucha E/S en bases de datos grandes.

force_checkpoint.location: Maintenance → FORCE CHECKPOINT Confirmation: warning that other active transactions will be aborted.
force_checkpoint.value: Anula cualquier transacción que siga ejecutándose en otras conexiones a esta base de datos en lugar de esperarla.

locks_long.location: Maintenance → Confirmation: warning shown for operations that lock objects and may run for a long time.
locks_long.value: Bloquea los objetos que toca y puede tardar mucho en tablas grandes.

optimize.location: Maintenance → OPTIMIZE TABLE Confirmation: warning about table rebuilding and locking.
optimize.value: Reconstruye el almacenamiento de la tabla; la tabla permanece bloqueada durante la operación en la mayoría de los motores de almacenamiento.

optimize_final.location: Maintenance → ClickHouse OPTIMIZE FINAL Confirmation: warning about full data rewriting and I/O cost.
optimize_final.value: Combina todas las partes de la tabla en una y reescribe todos sus datos; consume mucha E/S y puede tardar mucho en tablas grandes.

oracle_schema_stats.location: Maintenance → Oracle Schema Statistics Confirmation: warning about gathering statistics for every table.
oracle_schema_stats.value: Recopila estadísticas de todas las tablas del esquema; puede tardar mucho en esquemas grandes.

oracle_validate.location: Maintenance → Oracle Validation Confirmation: warning about full block reads and shared locking.
oracle_validate.value: Lee todos los bloques de la tabla y sus índices y mantiene un bloqueo compartido durante la operación.

reindex_database.location: Maintenance → Rebuild All Indexes Confirmation: warning about rebuilding and locking every table.
reindex_database.value: Reconstruye todos los índices de la base de datos, bloqueando cada tabla por turno; puede tardar mucho.

sqlite_vacuum.location: Maintenance → SQLite VACUUM Confirmation: warning about exclusive database-file access.
sqlite_vacuum.value: Reescribe todo el archivo de base de datos y necesita acceso exclusivo hasta que termine.

vacuum_full.location: Maintenance → VACUUM FULL Confirmation: warning about exclusive table locking.
vacuum_full.value: Reescribe toda la tabla con un bloqueo exclusivo; nada más puede leerla ni escribirla hasta que termine.

node_not_found.location: Schema Explorer → Metadata Error: message shown when a requested metadata node no longer exists.

permission_denied.location: Schema Explorer → Metadata Error: message shown when access to an object is denied.

query_failed.location: Schema Explorer → Metadata Query Error: wrapper shown when metadata loading fails; preserve the server detail.

engine_unsupported.value: SQLLY todavía no puede leer el catálogo de {engine_name}
engine_unsupported.location: Object Explorer → Load schema objects: error when the connection's engine has no catalog support yet; {engine_name} is the engine, e.g. IBM Db2.

connect_tls_untrusted_certificate.location: Connection editor → Test Connection, and the connection error shown when connecting to a MySQL or MariaDB server: message shown when the server's TLS certificate is self-signed or from an unknown certificate authority and the TLS mode verifies it; {server} is the server name the user entered and {detail} is the raw driver error. Keep SQL statements, server setting names, plugin names and product names as they are; the quoted TLS option names must match the TLS dropdown in the connection editor.
connect_tls_untrusted_certificate.value: Error de conexión: el certificado TLS de {server} no es de confianza. Está autofirmado o lo emitió una autoridad de certificación que este equipo no conoce, y el modo TLS de esta conexión comprueba el certificado. MariaDB 11.4 y posteriores y MySQL 5.7 y posteriores crean por sí solos un certificado autofirmado, así que esto es normal en un servidor local o de pruebas. Para conectarte, edita la conexión y establece TLS en "Requerir (sin verificación)" (sigue cifrada), o mantén la verificación y elige el archivo de certificado de la CA del servidor en la sección TLS. Detalle del controlador: {detail}

connect_tls_hostname_mismatch.location: Connection editor → Test Connection, and the connection error shown when connecting to a MySQL or MariaDB server: message shown when the server's TLS certificate does not list the host name being connected to; {server} is the server name the user entered and {detail} is the raw driver error. Keep SQL statements, server setting names, plugin names and product names as they are; the quoted TLS option names must match the TLS dropdown in the connection editor.
connect_tls_hostname_mismatch.value: Error de conexión: el certificado TLS de {server} se emitió para otro nombre de host. No incluye el nombre o la dirección con que te conectas, y el modo TLS "Verificación completa" lo comprueba. Para conectarte, usa el nombre de host para el que se emitió el certificado, o edita la conexión y establece TLS en "Verificar CA" (comprueba la autoridad de certificación pero no el nombre de host). Detalle del controlador: {detail}

connect_tls_certificate_expired.location: Connection editor → Test Connection, and the connection error shown when connecting to a MySQL or MariaDB server: message shown when the server's TLS certificate has expired or is not yet valid; {server} is the server name the user entered and {detail} is the raw driver error. Keep SQL statements, server setting names, plugin names and product names as they are; the quoted TLS option names must match the TLS dropdown in the connection editor.
connect_tls_certificate_expired.value: Error de conexión: el certificado TLS de {server} ha caducado o todavía no es válido. Comprueba que la fecha y la hora de este equipo sean correctas; si lo son, hay que renovar el certificado en el servidor. Para conectarte sin comprobar el certificado, edita la conexión y establece TLS en "Requerir (sin verificación)". Detalle del controlador: {detail}

connect_tls_failed.location: Connection editor → Test Connection, and the connection error shown when connecting to a MySQL or MariaDB server: message shown when the TLS handshake fails for a reason other than an untrusted, mismatched or expired certificate; {server} is the server name the user entered and {detail} is the raw driver error. Keep SQL statements, server setting names, plugin names and product names as they are; the quoted TLS option names must match the TLS dropdown in the connection editor.
connect_tls_failed.value: Error de conexión: no se pudo establecer la conexión cifrada (TLS) con {server}. El servidor y SQLLY no pudieron acordar la configuración de TLS, o se rechazó un certificado. Revisa la sección TLS de la conexión: el modo TLS, el archivo de certificado de la CA y el certificado y la clave de cliente. Detalle del controlador: {detail}

connect_tls_not_enabled_on_server.location: Connection editor → Test Connection, and the connection error shown when connecting to a MySQL or MariaDB server: message shown when the connection's TLS mode requires encryption but the server has TLS turned off; {server} is the server name the user entered and {detail} is the raw driver error. Keep SQL statements, server setting names, plugin names and product names as they are; the quoted TLS option names must match the TLS dropdown in the connection editor.
connect_tls_not_enabled_on_server.value: Error de conexión: {server} no tiene TLS (SSL) activado, pero el modo TLS de esta conexión exige una conexión cifrada, y SQLLY nunca pasa por su cuenta a una conexión sin cifrar. Para conectarte, edita la conexión y establece TLS en "Desactivar" (la conexión no estará cifrada), o activa TLS en el servidor. MariaDB 11.3 y anteriores tiene TLS desactivado salvo que se haya configurado. Detalle del controlador: {detail}

connect_socket_only_account.location: Connection editor → Test Connection, and the connection error shown when connecting to a MySQL or MariaDB server: message shown when the server refuses an account that may only sign in through the local Unix socket (server error 1698); {user} is the account name and {detail} is the raw server error. Keep SQL statements, server setting names, plugin names and product names as they are; the quoted TLS option names must match the TLS dropdown in the connection editor.
connect_socket_only_account.value: Error de autenticación: la cuenta {user} solo puede iniciar sesión a través del socket Unix local del servidor, no por la red. SQLLY se conecta por la red (TCP), así que el servidor rechaza esta cuenta sea cual sea la contraseña que escribas. Es la configuración predeterminada de root y de tu usuario del sistema operativo en las instalaciones de MariaDB y MySQL con Homebrew, paquetes o instaladores. Para conectarte, asigna una contraseña a la cuenta en el cliente de línea de comandos mysql o mariadb, por ejemplo ALTER USER '{user}'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY 'a-new-password'; o crea otro usuario que tenga contraseña, y luego escribe esa contraseña aquí. Detalle del servidor: {detail}

connect_access_denied.location: Connection editor → Test Connection, and the connection error shown when connecting to a MySQL or MariaDB server: message shown when the server rejects the user name or password (server error 1045); {user} is the account name and {detail} is the raw server error. Keep SQL statements, server setting names, plugin names and product names as they are; the quoted TLS option names must match the TLS dropdown in the connection editor.
connect_access_denied.value: Error de autenticación: el servidor rechazó el nombre de usuario o la contraseña de {user}. Revisa que ninguno tenga errores. Las cuentas de MySQL y MariaDB están ligadas a la dirección desde la que te conectas, así que una cuenta creada para 'localhost' puede no aceptar una conexión desde otra dirección, y el mismo nombre de usuario puede tener una contraseña distinta para cada dirección. Detalle del servidor: {detail}

connect_access_denied_no_password.location: Connection editor → Test Connection, and the connection error shown when connecting to a MySQL or MariaDB server: message shown when the server rejects a sign-in because no password was sent (server error 1045, using password: NO); {user} is the account name and {detail} is the raw server error. Keep SQL statements, server setting names, plugin names and product names as they are; the quoted TLS option names must match the TLS dropdown in the connection editor.
connect_access_denied_no_password.value: Error de autenticación: no se envió ninguna contraseña para {user}, y el servidor exige una para esta cuenta. Edita la conexión, escribe la contraseña y vuelve a intentarlo. Detalle del servidor: {detail}

connect_host_not_allowed.location: Connection editor → Test Connection, and the connection error shown when connecting to a MySQL or MariaDB server: message shown when the server does not allow any account to connect from this computer's address (server error 1130); {detail} is the raw server error. Keep SQL statements, server setting names, plugin names and product names as they are; the quoted TLS option names must match the TLS dropdown in the connection editor.
connect_host_not_allowed.value: Error de conexión: el servidor no acepta inicios de sesión desde la dirección de este equipo. Ninguna cuenta del servidor está configurada para conectarse desde aquí; a menudo las cuentas se crean solo para 'localhost'. En el servidor, crea o cambia una cuenta para que su parte de host coincida con este equipo (por ejemplo 'user'@'%'), o conéctate a través de un túnel SSH. Detalle del servidor: {detail}

connect_unknown_database.location: Connection editor → Test Connection, and the connection error shown when connecting to a MySQL or MariaDB server: message shown when the database named in the connection does not exist (server error 1049); {database} is the database name the user entered and {detail} is the raw server error. Keep SQL statements, server setting names, plugin names and product names as they are; the quoted TLS option names must match the TLS dropdown in the connection editor.
connect_unknown_database.value: Error de conexión: la base de datos "{database}" no existe en este servidor. El nombre de usuario y la contraseña se aceptaron. Edita la conexión y corrige el campo Base de datos, o déjalo vacío para conectarte sin base de datos predeterminada. Detalle del servidor: {detail}

connect_database_access_denied.location: Connection editor → Test Connection, and the connection error shown when connecting to a MySQL or MariaDB server: message shown when the account signed in but may not use the database named in the connection (server error 1044); {user} is the account name, {database} is the database name and {detail} is the raw server error. Keep SQL statements, server setting names, plugin names and product names as they are; the quoted TLS option names must match the TLS dropdown in the connection editor.
connect_database_access_denied.value: Error de conexión: la cuenta {user} inició sesión, pero no tiene permiso para usar la base de datos "{database}". Edita la conexión y elige una base de datos que esta cuenta pueda usar o deja vacío el campo Base de datos, o concede acceso a la cuenta en el servidor. Detalle del servidor: {detail}

connect_too_many_connections.location: Connection editor → Test Connection, and the connection error shown when connecting to a MySQL or MariaDB server: message shown when the server refuses new connections because it reached its connection limit (server error 1040); {server} is the server name the user entered and {detail} is the raw server error. Keep SQL statements, server setting names, plugin names and product names as they are; the quoted TLS option names must match the TLS dropdown in the connection editor.
connect_too_many_connections.value: Error de conexión: {server} alcanzó su límite de conexiones abiertas y rechaza las nuevas. Cierra las conexiones que ya no hagan falta, o aumenta max_connections en el servidor, y vuelve a intentarlo. Detalle del servidor: {detail}

connect_refused.location: Connection editor → Test Connection, and the connection error shown when connecting to a MySQL or MariaDB server: message shown when nothing is listening at the host and port; {server} and {port} are the host and port the user entered and {detail} is the raw driver error. Keep SQL statements, server setting names, plugin names and product names as they are; the quoted TLS option names must match the TLS dropdown in the connection editor.
connect_refused.value: Error de conexión: nada acepta conexiones en {server} en el puerto {port}. O el servidor no está en ejecución, o escucha en otro puerto, o está configurado para aceptar solo conexiones por socket local (skip-networking) o conexiones en otra dirección de red (bind-address). Inicia el servidor y revisa los campos Servidor y Puerto. Detalle del controlador: {detail}

connect_host_not_found.location: Connection editor → Test Connection, and the connection error shown when connecting to a MySQL or MariaDB server: message shown when the host name cannot be resolved; {server} is the server name the user entered and {detail} is the raw driver error. Keep SQL statements, server setting names, plugin names and product names as they are; the quoted TLS option names must match the TLS dropdown in the connection editor.
connect_host_not_found.value: Error de conexión: no se encontró el nombre de host "{server}". Revisa que el campo Servidor no tenga errores y que tu conexión de red o VPN esté activa. Detalle del controlador: {detail}

connect_timed_out.location: Connection editor → Test Connection, and the connection error shown when connecting to a MySQL or MariaDB server: message shown when the server does not complete the connection within the connection timeout; {server} and {port} are the host and port the user entered and {seconds} is the timeout in whole seconds. Keep SQL statements, server setting names, plugin names and product names as they are; the quoted TLS option names must match the TLS dropdown in the connection editor.
connect_timed_out.value: Error de conexión: se agotó el tiempo de espera al conectar con {server} en el puerto {port}; no hubo una respuesta completa dentro del tiempo de espera de {seconds} segundos. Puede que la dirección o el puerto sean incorrectos, que un firewall bloquee el puerto, o que el servidor solo sea accesible a través de una VPN o un túnel SSH.

connect_auth_plugin_unsupported.location: Connection editor → Test Connection, and the connection error shown when connecting to a MySQL or MariaDB server: message shown when the account uses a sign-in plugin SQLLY cannot use; {user} is the account name and {plugin} is the plugin name reported by the server. Keep SQL statements, server setting names, plugin names and product names as they are; the quoted TLS option names must match the TLS dropdown in the connection editor.
connect_auth_plugin_unsupported.value: Error de autenticación: la cuenta {user} inicia sesión con el complemento de autenticación "{plugin}", que SQLLY no admite. En el servidor, cambia la cuenta a mysql_native_password (o caching_sha2_password en MySQL), o conéctate con otra cuenta.

cleartext_guidance.location: Connection Editor → MySQL Cleartext Authentication: guidance shown when PAM or LDAP requires cleartext password support and TLS must be enabled.
cleartext_guidance.value: Esta cuenta de MySQL inicia sesión con una contraseña en texto claro (autenticación PAM o LDAP). SQLLY solo la envía mediante una conexión cifrada con un certificado de servidor verificado: establece TLS en Verify CA o Verify full en el editor de conexiones.

authentication_unsupported.location: Native Dump/Restore → Connection Validation: error shown when the connection’s sign-in method (e.g. Microsoft Entra or a token) cannot be passed to the external pg_dump/mysqldump-style tools.
authentication_unsupported.value: Error de autenticación: este tipo de autenticación no es compatible con las herramientas nativas de la base de datos

relay_route_unsupported.location: Native Dump/Restore → Connection Validation: error shown when the connection is routed through a relay bridge, which the locally run backup and restore tools cannot reach.
relay_route_unsupported.value: Perfil de conexión no válido: las herramientas nativas de copia de seguridad y restauración necesitan una conexión directa; a esta conexión se llega a través de un puente de retransmisión

username_required.location: Native Dump/Restore → Connection Validation: message shown when the external tool needs a database username.
username_required.value: se requiere un nombre de usuario

extra_option_reserved.location: Export Database as SQL → MySQL native → Extra options: validation error shown when the user types an option the app controls itself, such as the output file, credentials or server address; {option} is the option as typed.
extra_option_reserved.value: SQLLY ya define {option}, así que no puede ser una opción adicional de mysqldump

extra_option_not_an_option.location: Export Database as SQL → MySQL native → Extra options: validation error shown when a typed entry is not a long option starting with two dashes; {option} is the offending entry as typed.
extra_option_not_an_option.value: Cada opción adicional de mysqldump debe ser una opción larga que empiece por -- ({option})

extra_option_unclosed_quote.location: Export Database as SQL → MySQL native → Extra options: validation error shown under the field when a single or double quote in the typed options is never closed.
extra_option_unclosed_quote.value: Hay una comilla sin cerrar en las opciones adicionales de mysqldump

spawn_failed.value: Error de conexión: no se pudo iniciar {program}: {detail}
spawn_failed.location: Tools → Backup / Restore → Native tool run: error when the vendor command-line tool (pg_dump, mysqldump, pg_restore, mysql, …) cannot be started; {program} is the tool's path and {detail} the operating-system error.

wait_failed.value: Error de conexión: falló la espera de la herramienta nativa de base de datos: {detail}
wait_failed.location: Tools → Backup / Restore → Native tool run: error when SQLLY loses track of the running vendor command-line tool before it finishes; {detail} is the operating-system error.

tool_failed.value: Error de conexión: la herramienta nativa de base de datos terminó con el código {exit_code}: {detail}
tool_failed.location: Tools → Backup / Restore → Native tool run: error when the vendor command-line tool finishes unsuccessfully; {exit_code} is its exit code and {detail} the last lines of its output, kept as printed.

unsupported_dump_tool.value: Esta herramienta nativa no puede crear copias de seguridad
unsupported_dump_tool.location: Tools → Backup / Restore → Back up with native tool: error when the selected vendor tool is a restore-only tool that cannot write a backup.

unsupported_restore_tool.value: Esta herramienta nativa no puede restaurar copias de seguridad
unsupported_restore_tool.location: Tools → Backup / Restore → Restore with native tool: error when the selected vendor tool is a backup-only tool that cannot restore a backup.

datetime_range.location: Date Helper → Preview: date-time range spanning multiple days, displayed numerically.

datetime_same_day.location: Date Helper → Preview: date-time range within one day, with only the end time after the separator.

range_different_years.location: Date Helper → Preview: date-only range spanning different years, displayed numerically.

range_same_year.location: Date Helper → Preview: date-only range whose endpoints share a year, displayed numerically.

relative_now.location: Date Helper → Relative Preview: range from a numeric start date and time through now.

relative_today.location: Date Helper → Relative Preview: range from a numeric start date and time through today.

single.location: Date Helper → Preview: single date and time resulting from a natural-language phrase.

single_date.location: Date Helper → Preview: single date-only result from a natural-language phrase.

client_missing.location: Oracle Connection → Missing Client: installation guidance shown when Oracle Instant Client cannot be loaded.
client_missing.value: No se encontró Oracle Instant Client: SQLLY carga la biblioteca cliente de Oracle ({library_name}) al conectarse. Instala Oracle Instant Client (Basic o Basic Light) desde https://www.oracle.com/database/technologies/instant-client/downloads.html, coloca {library_name} donde pueda encontrarse ({search_paths}) o establece {environment_variable} en su carpeta y reinicia SQLLY.

client_missing_detail.location: Oracle Connection → Missing Client: installation guidance with the Oracle loader's raw diagnostic detail.
client_missing_detail.value: No se encontró Oracle Instant Client: SQLLY carga la biblioteca cliente de Oracle ({library_name}) al conectarse. Instala Oracle Instant Client (Basic o Basic Light) desde https://www.oracle.com/database/technologies/instant-client/downloads.html, coloca {library_name} donde pueda encontrarse ({search_paths}) o establece {environment_variable} en su carpeta y reinicia SQLLY. ({detail})

direct_tls_hint.location: Connection Editor → PostgreSQL Direct TLS: guidance shown when an older server rejects direct TLS; preserve the handshake detail.
direct_tls_hint.value: Error de conexión: {detail}. TLS directo requiere PostgreSQL 17 o posterior; desmarca «TLS directo (PostgreSQL 17+)» en el editor de conexiones si el servidor es anterior.

delta_added.location: Execution Plan → Compare Captures: badge for an operator present only in the comparison capture.

delta_improved.location: Execution Plan → Compare Captures: badge for an operator whose cost or warnings improved.

delta_regressed.location: Execution Plan → Compare Captures: badge for an operator whose cost or warnings worsened.

delta_removed.location: Execution Plan → Compare Captures: badge for an operator present only in the baseline capture.

baseline_too_large.location: Execution Plan → Compare Captures → Size limit error: message shown when the baseline exceeds the operator limit.
baseline_too_large.value: La captura base tiene {node_count} operadores; la comparación está limitada a {node_limit} por captura

comparison_too_large.location: Execution Plan → Compare Captures → Size limit error: message shown when the comparison exceeds the operator limit.
comparison_too_large.value: La captura de comparación tiene {node_count} operadores; la comparación está limitada a {node_limit} por captura

empty.location: Execution Plan → Compare Captures → Validation error: message shown when either capture is empty.
empty.value: Ambas capturas deben contener al menos una instrucción

statement_count.location: Execution Plan → Compare Captures → Compatibility error: message shown when captures contain different numbers of statements.
statement_count.value: Las capturas contienen diferentes cantidades de instrucciones ({baseline_count} frente a {comparison_count})

statement_type.location: Execution Plan → Compare Captures → Compatibility error: message shown when corresponding statements have different SQL operation types.
statement_type.value: La instrucción {statement_number} cambió de tipo ({baseline_type} frente a {comparison_type})

empty_plan.location: Execution Plan → Parse error: message shown when a captured plan contains no executable statement.

invalid_structure.location: Execution Plan → Structure error: message shown when plan content does not have the required operator structure.

xml_parse.location: Execution Plan → Parse error: wrapper shown when plan XML cannot be parsed; preserve the parser detail.

action.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Missing Statistics: recommended statistics update.
action.value: Crea o actualiza estadísticas en las columnas filtradas y combinadas.

detail.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Missing Statistics → Expanded Details: operator and cost information.
detail.value:
Operador: {operator} (nodo {node_id})
ColumnsWithNoStatistics
Proporción del costo: {cost_percent} %

summary.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Missing Statistics: summary of missing column statistics.
summary.value: El optimizador no tiene estadísticas para al menos una columna aquí

why.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Missing Statistics: explanation of unreliable row estimates.
why.value: Sin estadísticas, las estimaciones de filas son conjeturas y las decisiones de combinación y acceso basadas en ellas pueden ser muy equivocadas.

action.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Estimate Mismatch: recommended statistics update and plan review.
action.value: Ejecuta UPDATE STATISTICS en las tablas que lee este operador y vuelve a revisar el plan.

detail.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Estimate Mismatch → Expanded Details: row counts, divergence, operator, and cost.

summary.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Estimate Mismatch: summary comparing estimated and actual row counts.
summary.value: Se estimaron {estimated_rows} filas, pero se leyeron {actual_rows}

why.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Estimate Mismatch: explanation of likely stale statistics.
why.value: Unas estimaciones tan alejadas suelen indicar estadísticas obsoletas, por lo que el optimizador puede elegir un orden de combinación o método de acceso incorrecto para el volumen real de datos.

action.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Implicit Conversion: recommended data-type correction.
action.value: Haz coincidir el tipo de datos del parámetro o de la columna comparada con el tipo de la columna para que el predicado pueda usar búsquedas.

detail.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Implicit Conversion → Expanded Details: expression, operator, and cost information.

summary_expression.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Implicit Conversion: summary naming the converted expression; preserve the SQL expression.
summary_expression.value: Convierte `{expression}` en cada fila, lo que impide búsquedas en índices

summary_value.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Implicit Conversion: summary shown when the plan does not name the converted expression.
summary_value.value: Convierte un valor en cada fila, lo que impide búsquedas en índices

why.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Implicit Conversion: explanation of why conversion prevents index seeks.
why.value: Una comparación que cambia el tipo de una columna no puede buscar en un índice; el índice se examina y cada fila se convierte antes de poder compararse.

action_named_index.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Key Lookup: recommendation naming the affected index.
action_named_index.value: Agrega las columnas seleccionadas como columnas INCLUDE en {index_name} o selecciona menos columnas.

action_unknown_index.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Key Lookup: recommendation shown when the index name is unavailable.
action_unknown_index.value: Agrega las columnas seleccionadas como columnas INCLUDE en el índice o selecciona menos columnas.

detail.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Key Lookup → Expanded Details: operator, table, index, and cost information.

summary.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Key Lookup: summary naming the table whose rows are read again.
summary.value: Busca en el índice y luego vuelve a leer cada fila coincidente de {table_name}

why.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Key Lookup: explanation of the additional reads.
why.value: El índice localiza las filas, pero no contiene todas las columnas que selecciona la consulta, por lo que cada coincidencia requiere una lectura adicional de la tabla base.

action_without_columns.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Missing Index: recommendation shown when key columns are unavailable.
action_without_columns.value: Crea un índice no clúster en {table_name} que cubra las columnas filtradas y combinadas.

detail.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Missing Index → Expanded Details: complete optimizer suggestion and cost information.

summary_with_columns.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Missing Index: summary naming the table and suggested key columns.

summary_without_columns.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Missing Index: summary shown when the plan does not supply key columns.

why_with_impact.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Missing Index: explanation including the optimizer's estimated improvement.
why_with_impact.value: El optimizador estima que este índice mejoraría esta instrucción aproximadamente un {impact_percent} %. Calculó el índice que necesitaba y no lo encontró.

why_without_impact.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Missing Index: explanation shown when no improvement estimate is available.
why_without_impact.value: El optimizador calculó un índice que necesitaba para esta instrucción y no lo encontró.

action.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Missing Join Predicate: recommended correction for the join.
action.value: Agrega una cláusula ON que relacione las dos tablas. Si el producto cartesiano completo es intencional, escribe CROSS JOIN explícitamente.

detail.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Missing Join Predicate → Expanded Details: operator and cost information.
detail.value:
Operador: {operator} (nodo {node_id})
NoJoinPredicate=true
Proporción del costo: {cost_percent} %

summary.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Missing Join Predicate: summary of a join without an ON condition.
summary.value: Una combinación no tiene condición ON, por lo que cada fila se empareja con todas las demás

why.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Missing Join Predicate: explanation of the cross-product impact.
why.value: Sin un predicado de combinación, el resultado es un producto cartesiano: dos tablas de 1000 filas producen 1 000 000 filas antes de aplicar cualquier filtro.

action.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Unclassified Optimizer Warning: suggested next step.
action.value: Inspecciona las propiedades del operador para ver los detalles.

detail.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Unclassified Optimizer Warning → Expanded Details: operator, raw warning, and cost information.

summary.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Unclassified Optimizer Warning: summary preserving the raw optimizer warning.

why.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Unclassified Optimizer Warning: explanation that no more specific classification exists.
why.value: El optimizador señaló algo que no pudo clasificar.

action.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Row Goal: guidance on when further investigation is useful.
action.value: Normalmente no es un problema. Si el resultado completo es lento, revisa la cláusula TOP o EXISTS que lo provoca.
