detail.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Row Goal → Expanded Details: operator and cost information.
detail.value:
Operador: {operator} (nodo {node_id})
Proporción del costo: {cost_percent} %

summary.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Row Goal: summary explaining the optimizer's row-goal strategy.
summary.value: Usa un objetivo de filas, que prioriza detenerse pronto sobre el costo total

why.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Row Goal: explanation of the performance trade-off.
why.value: Los objetivos de filas (TOP, EXISTS, FAST n) hacen que el optimizador elija planes que devuelven las primeras filas rápidamente, a veces con un costo total mayor.

action.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Tempdb Spill: recommended ways to reduce spilling.
action.value: Actualiza las estadísticas para mejorar la estimación de memoria, reduce las filas que llegan a este operador o simplifica la ordenación o eliminación de duplicados.

detail.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Tempdb Spill → Expanded Details: operator, row estimate, and cost information.
detail.value:
Operador: {operator} (nodo {node_id})
SpillToTempDb
Filas estimadas: {estimated_rows}
Proporción del costo: {cost_percent} %

summary.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Tempdb Spill: summary naming the operator that spills.
summary.value: {operator} desborda a tempdb porque su asignación de memoria es demasiado pequeña

why.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Tempdb Spill: explanation of the performance impact.
why.value: Escribir resultados intermedios en disco es órdenes de magnitud más lento que mantenerlos en memoria.

action.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Spool: guidance on when to investigate.
action.value: Normalmente es inofensivo. Investiga solo si este operador concentra la mayor parte del costo.

detail.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Spool → Expanded Details: operator and cost information.
detail.value:
Operador: {operator} (nodo {node_id})
Proporción del costo: {cost_percent} %

summary.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Spool: summary explaining that intermediate rows are cached.
summary.value: Almacena filas intermedias en caché mediante un spool

why.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Spool: explanation of benefits and possible hidden index problems.
why.value: Un spool relee filas con poco costo, lo que suele ayudar a una búsqueda repetida, pero en la ruta crítica puede ocultar un índice ausente.

action.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Table Scan: recommended indexing action.
action.value: Si este filtro se ejecuta con frecuencia, agrega un índice en las columnas filtradas o combinadas para que el examen se convierta en una búsqueda.

detail.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Table Scan → Expanded Details: operator, table, row estimate, and cost.

summary.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Table Scan: summary naming the table and estimated rows scanned.
summary.value: Examina todas las filas de {table_name} ({estimated_rows} filas) para encontrar coincidencias

why.location: Execution Plan → Findings → Table Scan: explanation of full-table read cost.
why.value: Un examen de tabla no tiene un índice en el que buscar, por lo que lee toda la tabla cada vez. El costo aumenta con el tamaño de la tabla incluso cuando la consulta devuelve una fila.

detail.location: Execution Plan → Operators → Expanded Details: full technical detail shown after expanding an operator; keep operator names, warning data, and output columns unchanged.

summary_actual.location: Execution Plan → Operators: compact row summary for an actual plan operator with estimated and actual rows.

summary_estimated.location: Execution Plan → Operators: compact row summary for an estimated plan operator.

embedding_fallback.location: AI Settings → Provider Diagnostics: notice shown when the requested embedding provider falls back to another provider.
embedding_fallback.value: Se solicitó el proveedor de incrustaciones '{requested_provider}', pero no está disponible; se usará '{active_provider}' en su lugar.

embedding_fallback_with_reason.location: AI Settings → Provider Diagnostics: notice with diagnostic detail when the requested embedding provider falls back; preserve the raw detail.
embedding_fallback_with_reason.value: Se solicitó el proveedor de incrustaciones '{requested_provider}', pero no está disponible; se usará '{active_provider}' en su lugar. ({detail})

llm_fallback.location: AI Settings → Provider Diagnostics: notice shown when the requested language-model provider falls back to another provider.
llm_fallback.value: Se solicitó el proveedor de LLM '{requested_provider}', pero no está disponible; se usará '{active_provider}' en su lugar.

llm_fallback_with_reason.location: AI Settings → Provider Diagnostics: notice with diagnostic detail when the requested language-model provider falls back; preserve the raw detail.
llm_fallback_with_reason.value: Se solicitó el proveedor de LLM '{requested_provider}', pero no está disponible; se usará '{active_provider}' en su lugar. ({detail})

cancelled.location: Query Execution → Cancellation: message shown after the user cancels execution.

empty.location: Query Execution → Validation Error: message shown when there is no SQL to execute.

execution_failed.location: Query Execution → Execution Error: wrapper shown when execution fails; preserve the server detail.
execution_failed.value: La ejecución de la consulta falló: {detail}

manual_commit_connection_kind_unsupporte.location: Query tab → Manual commit mode → Begin transaction: error when the connection’s protocol cannot hold a pinned transaction; {connection_kind} is the internal protocol name, e.g. SqliteFile, and stays untranslated.
manual_commit_connection_kind_unsupporte.value: El modo de confirmación manual no es compatible con las conexiones {connection_kind}

manual_commit_engine_unsupported.location: Query tab → Manual commit mode → Begin transaction: error when the selected database engine has no manual-commit support; {engine_name} is the engine, e.g. SQLite.
manual_commit_engine_unsupported.value: El modo de confirmación manual no es compatible con {engine_name}

manual_commit_unavailable.location: Query tab → Manual commit mode → Begin or end transaction: error when the query service in use (e.g. a remote or browser one) has no manual-commit support.
manual_commit_unavailable.value: El modo de confirmación manual no está disponible en esta versión

no_connection.location: Query Execution → Connection Error: message shown when the session has no active connection.
no_connection.value: No hay una conexión activa para la sesión

session_not_found.location: Query Execution → Session Error: message shown when the requested query session no longer exists.

timeout.location: Query Execution → Timeout Error: message shown when execution exceeds its time limit.
timeout.value: La consulta superó el tiempo límite después de {duration}

pooled_connection_timeout.value: Error de conexión: la conexión reutilizada no respondió en {seconds} segundos
pooled_connection_timeout.location: Query tab → Run query → Connection reuse: error when a kept-open SQL Server connection does not answer its health check in time; {seconds} is the time limit.

monitor.location: Redis Query → Blocking Command Warning: guidance shown for MONITOR in the query editor.
monitor.value: {command_name} transmite todos los comandos que recibe el servidor hasta que se cierra la conexión; captúralo en la pestaña Generador de perfiles del Monitor de actividad (Herramientas > Generador de perfiles de Redis)

replicas.location: Redis Query → Blocking Command Warning: guidance shown for WAIT and WAITAOF with a zero timeout.
replicas.value: {command_name} con un tiempo de espera de 0 espera réplicas indefinidamente; asígnale un tiempo de espera positivo en milisegundos

replication.location: Redis Query → Blocking Command Warning: explanation shown for SYNC and PSYNC in the query editor.
replication.value: {command_name} inicia una transmisión de replicación que nunca termina

sharded_subscribe.location: Redis Query → Blocking Command Warning: guidance shown for SSUBSCRIBE in the query editor.
sharded_subscribe.value: {command_name} pone la conexión en modo suscriptor y espera mensajes indefinidamente; observa los canales fragmentados en la pestaña Pub/Sub del Monitor de actividad (Herramientas > Visor de Pub/Sub de Redis), introduciendo cada uno como #channel

stream.location: Redis Query → Blocking Command Warning: guidance shown for XREAD or XREADGROUP with BLOCK 0.
stream.value: {command_name} BLOCK 0 espera entradas indefinidamente; asigna a BLOCK un tiempo de espera positivo en milisegundos

subscribe.location: Redis Query → Blocking Command Warning: guidance shown for SUBSCRIBE and PSUBSCRIBE in the query editor.
subscribe.value: {command_name} pone la conexión en modo suscriptor y espera mensajes indefinidamente; observa los canales en la pestaña Pub/Sub del Monitor de actividad (Herramientas > Visor de Pub/Sub de Redis)

timeout.location: Redis Query → Blocking Command Warning: guidance shown for blocking list commands with a zero timeout.
timeout.value: {command_name} se bloquea hasta que llegue un elemento; asígnale un tiempo de espera positivo en segundos

mode_auto.location: Connection Editor → Redis Cluster Mode: option that detects cluster support automatically.

mode_cluster.location: Connection Editor → Redis Cluster Mode: option forcing cluster routing.

mode_standalone.location: Connection Editor → Redis Cluster Mode: option forcing standalone-server behavior.

redirect_many.location: Redis Cluster → Query Information: notice shown after multiple MOVED or ASK redirects.
redirect_many.value: Clúster: {redirect_count} redirecciones MOVED/ASK seguidas durante la ejecución de este script (las ranuras se movieron entre nodos; el mapa de ranuras del cliente ya está actualizado)

redirect_one.location: Redis Cluster → Query Information: notice shown after one MOVED or ASK redirect.
redirect_one.value: Clúster: {redirect_count} redirección MOVED/ASK seguida durante la ejecución de este script (las ranuras se movieron entre nodos; el mapa de ranuras del cliente ya está actualizado)

refusal_copy.location: Redis Cluster → Query Refusal: explanation shown for COPY … DB and the cross-connection alternative.
refusal_copy.value: COPY … DB está rechazado: un clúster tiene una única base de datos lógica (0); usa Copiar a conexión… para copiar una clave a otro servidor

refusal_cross_slot.location: Redis Cluster → Cross-Slot Query Refusal: explanation shown when a multi-key command crosses hash slots.
refusal_cross_slot.value: {command_name} nombra claves en {slot_count} ranuras hash diferentes ({slot_list}); un clúster ejecuta un comando multiclave solo cuando todas las claves se asignan a la misma ranura: asigna a las claves una {{hash tag}} común, como user:{{42}}:a y user:{{42}}:b

refusal_keys.location: Redis Cluster → Query Refusal: explanation shown for KEYS and the paged alternative.
refusal_keys.value: KEYS bloquearía todos los maestros mientras recorre todo el espacio de claves; en un clúster usa el explorador de claves o SQLLY.KEYS <pattern>, que examina cada maestro por páginas

refusal_move.location: Redis Cluster → Query Refusal: explanation shown for MOVE.
refusal_move.value: MOVE está rechazado: un clúster tiene una única base de datos lógica (0), por lo que no hay otra base de datos a la que mover una clave

refusal_scan.location: Redis Cluster → Query Refusal: explanation shown for SCAN and the cross-master cursor alternative.
refusal_scan.value: un cursor SCAN pertenece a un nodo, por lo que en un clúster no puede continuarse desde el editor; usa SQLLY.KEYS <pattern> [limit [cursor]], que recorre todos los maestros y devuelve un cursor que continúa entre ellos

refusal_select.location: Redis Cluster → Query Refusal: explanation shown when SELECT targets a nonzero logical database.
refusal_select.value: SELECT {database_name} está rechazado: un clúster tiene una única base de datos lógica (0)

refusal_transaction.location: Redis Cluster → Query Refusal: explanation shown for MULTI, EXEC, or DISCARD and the node-specific alternative.
refusal_transaction.value: {command_name} no está disponible en una conexión de clúster: cada comando se enruta al maestro de su propia ranura, por lo que una transacción no puede permanecer en un nodo; ejecuta la transacción con redis-cli -c contra el nodo propietario de sus claves con etiqueta hash

line_failed.location: Redis Test Connection → Diagnostics: failed stage log line with elapsed time and raw detail.

line_note.location: Redis Test Connection → Diagnostics: successful-with-note stage log line with elapsed time and raw detail.

line_ok.location: Redis Test Connection → Diagnostics: successful stage log line with elapsed time and raw detail.

line_skipped.location: Redis Test Connection → Diagnostics: skipped stage log line with elapsed time and raw detail.

stage_auth.location: Redis Test Connection → Diagnostics: stage label for authentication.

stage_cluster.location: Redis Test Connection → Diagnostics: stage label for cluster capability discovery.

stage_hello.location: Redis Test Connection → Diagnostics: stage label for protocol negotiation and liveness checks.

stage_resolve.location: Redis Test Connection → Diagnostics: stage label for hostname resolution.

stage_select.location: Redis Test Connection → Diagnostics: stage label for logical database selection.

stage_session.location: Redis Test Connection → Diagnostics: stage label for opening the real query session.

stage_tcp.location: Redis Test Connection → Diagnostics: stage label for the TCP connection.

stage_tls.location: Redis Test Connection → Diagnostics: stage label for TLS negotiation and certificate checks.

stage_tunnel.location: Redis Test Connection → Diagnostics: stage label for tunnel or proxy setup.

empty_command.location: Redis Query → Validation: message shown when no command is supplied.

handshakes_refused.location: Redis Connection → Protocol Error: message shown when both protocol handshakes are rejected.
handshakes_refused.value: Error de conexión: el servidor rechazó los handshakes RESP3 y RESP2

no_host.location: Connection Editor → Redis URL: validation error shown when the URL omits the server host.
no_host.value: La URL de Redis no tiene host

role_no_response.location: Redis Sentinel → Role Probe: diagnostic shown when ROLE returns no role value.
role_no_response.value: Error al ejecutar la consulta: ROLE no respondió nada

xpending_arguments.location: Redis Streams → XPENDING Validation: message shown when the key or consumer group is missing.
xpending_arguments.value: Error al ejecutar la consulta: SQLLY.XPENDING necesita una clave y un grupo

disconnected.location: Redis Live Capture → Capture Status: reason shown when the associated connection is disconnected or deleted.
disconnected.value: la conexión se desconectó; la conexión de captura está cerrada

monitor_ended.location: Redis Profiler → Capture Status: reason shown when the MONITOR stream ends unexpectedly.
monitor_ended.value: la transmisión MONITOR finalizó (el servidor cerró la conexión, la red falló o no se pudo leer una respuesta); la conexión de captura está cerrada

monitor_server_error.location: Redis Profiler → Capture Status: reason shown when Redis returns an error on the dedicated MONITOR connection; preserve the raw server detail.
monitor_server_error.value: el servidor envió un error en la conexión MONITOR: {detail}; la conexión de captura está cerrada

no_subscription_targets.location: Redis Pub/Sub → Start Subscription → Validation error: message shown when no channel or pattern was supplied.
no_subscription_targets.value: no hay canales ni patrones a los que suscribirse

start_failed.location: Redis Live Capture → Capture Status: reason shown when the dedicated capture connection cannot be opened; preserve the raw diagnostic detail.
start_failed.value: no se pudo iniciar la captura: {detail}

stopped.location: Redis Live Capture → Capture Status: reason shown after the user stops a profiler or subscription capture.
stopped.value: detenida; la conexión de captura está cerrada

subscription_ended.location: Redis Pub/Sub → Capture Status: reason shown when the subscription stream ends.
subscription_ended.value: la suscripción finalizó (el servidor cerró la conexión o la red falló); la conexión de captura está cerrada

time_box_minutes.location: Redis Profiler → Capture Status: reason shown when the configured minute-based time box ends the capture.
time_box_minutes.value: se alcanzó el límite de {minutes} min; la conexión de captura está cerrada

time_box_seconds.location: Redis Profiler → Capture Status: reason shown when the configured second-based time box ends the capture.
time_box_seconds.value: se alcanzó el límite de {seconds} s; la conexión de captura está cerrada

permission_denied.location: Redis Memory Analyzer → Measurement Availability: notice shown when the Redis ACL denies MEMORY USAGE; preserve the raw server detail.
permission_denied.value: Este usuario no tiene permiso para usar MEMORY USAGE ({detail})

unsupported.location: Redis Memory Analyzer → Measurement Availability: notice shown when the server does not support MEMORY USAGE; preserve the raw server detail.
unsupported.value: Este servidor no admite MEMORY USAGE ({detail})

invalid_port.location: Connection Editor → Redis Sentinel → Validation: message shown for an invalid sentinel port in a host entry.

missing_hosts.location: Connection Editor → Redis Sentinel → Validation: message shown when no sentinel host is supplied.
missing_hosts.value: Una conexión Sentinel necesita al menos un host sentinel

missing_master.location: Connection Editor → Redis Sentinel → Validation: message shown when the monitored master name is empty.
missing_master.value: Una conexión Sentinel necesita el nombre del maestro que vigilan los sentinel

summary.location: Redis Test Connection → Sentinel Summary: status line identifying the master selected by a sentinel.
summary.value: Sentinel {sentinel} nombró a {master} como maestro de '{master_name}'

summary_replica.location: Redis Test Connection → Sentinel Summary: status line identifying the master and read-only replica selected by a sentinel.
summary_replica.value: Sentinel {sentinel} nombró a {master} como maestro de '{master_name}'; los scripts de solo lectura usan la réplica {replica}

unclosed_ipv6.location: Connection Editor → Redis Sentinel → Validation: message shown for an IPv6 host with an unmatched bracket.
unclosed_ipv6.value: "{host}" tiene un corchete IPv6 sin cerrar

tunnel_reestablished.location: Redis Query → Tunnel Recovery Notice: warning shown after a dropped SSH tunnel is reopened, explaining that commands were not replayed.
tunnel_reestablished.value: Túnel restablecido: la sesión SSH se había interrumpido, por lo que se abrió un túnel nuevo para esta ejecución. No se volvió a ejecutar nada; si un comando se estaba ejecutando cuando se interrumpió el túnel, comprueba si tuvo efecto antes de ejecutarlo de nuevo.

authentication.location: Authentication Error → Remediation: suggested next steps after authentication fails.
authentication.value: Verifica las credenciales, el inquilino de Entra, los requisitos de MFA y la asignación del usuario de base de datos.

connection.location: Connection Error → Remediation: suggested next steps for a general connection failure.
connection.value: Verifica el nombre del servidor, el puerto, la configuración TLS y la accesibilidad de la red.

connection_timeout.location: Connection Error → Remediation: suggested next steps when the connection diagnostic indicates a timeout.
connection_timeout.value: Comprueba la conectividad de red y las reglas del firewall, y aumenta el tiempo límite de conexión si es necesario.

general.location: Operation Error → Remediation: generic suggested next step when no more specific guidance applies.
general.value: Revisa los detalles de la operación e inténtalo de nuevo si cambió el estado del servidor.

query.location: Query Error → Remediation: suggested review action preserving the raw server message.
query.value: Revisa el lote SQL y el mensaje del servidor: {detail}

auth_failed.location: Relay Connection → Authentication Error: guidance shown when relay authentication expires or fails.
auth_failed.value: La autenticación de retransmisión falló. Inicia sesión de nuevo para renovar tu acceso.

dest_offline.location: Relay Connection → Device Offline: guidance shown when the selected relay device cannot be reached.
dest_offline.value: El dispositivo de retransmisión de esta conexión está sin conexión. Inicia el puente SQLLY en ese equipo e inténtalo de nuevo.

full.location: Relay Connection → Capacity Error: message shown when the relay server has no capacity.
full.value: El servidor de retransmisión está al máximo de su capacidad. Inténtalo de nuevo en breve.

protocol_error.location: Relay Connection → Protocol Error: message shown when the relay rejects session negotiation.
protocol_error.value: La retransmisión rechazó la sesión (error de protocolo). Inténtalo de nuevo.

rate_limited.location: Relay Connection → Rate Limit: message shown when relay requests are rate limited.
rate_limited.value: Demasiadas solicitudes de retransmisión. Espera un momento e inténtalo de nuevo.

routing_denied.location: Relay Connection → Routing Denied: guidance shown when the connection is not authorized for the relay device.
routing_denied.value: Esta conexión no está autorizada para usar ese dispositivo de retransmisión. Vuelve a autorizar el emparejamiento en tu cuenta.

session_limit.location: Relay Connection → Session Limit: guidance shown when all concurrent bridge sessions are occupied.
session_limit.value: Se alcanzó el límite de conexiones simultáneas de este puente. Libera un espacio en la página de retransmisiones (o pide al propietario del puente que lo haga) e inténtalo de nuevo.

bridge_old_batch_save.location: Relay Grid Editor → Batch Save Error: guidance shown when the bridge cannot apply staged batch edits.
bridge_old_batch_save.value: El puente SQLLY de esta conexión de retransmisión es una versión anterior que no puede guardar cambios preparados de la cuadrícula; actualiza el puente o edita las filas una por una en el editor de filas

bridge_old_expression_column.location: Relay Row Editor → Column Expression Error: capability guidance naming the column whose expression the old bridge cannot evaluate.
bridge_old_expression_column.value: El puente SQLLY de esta conexión de retransmisión es una versión anterior que no puede evaluar la fecha del servidor, el UUID del servidor o el usuario actual; actualiza el puente o usa Nuevo UUID o la marca de tiempo del reloj local (columna {column_name})

bridge_old_expressions.location: Relay Row Editor → Capability Error: guidance shown when the bridge cannot evaluate server expressions.
bridge_old_expressions.value: El puente SQLLY de esta conexión de retransmisión es una versión anterior que no puede evaluar la fecha del servidor, el UUID del servidor o el usuario actual; actualiza el puente o usa Nuevo UUID o la marca de tiempo del reloj local

unavailable.location: Relay Row Editor → Capability Error: message shown when row editing is unavailable for the relay transport.
unavailable.value: la edición de filas no está disponible mediante una conexión de retransmisión

auto_rollback.location: Row Editor → Connection Policy: reason shown when the automatic-rollback playground policy prevents persistent row edits.
auto_rollback.value: esta conexión revierte automáticamente los cambios de datos; las ediciones de filas no se conservarían

select_only.location: Row Editor → Connection Policy: reason shown when the SELECT-only connection policy prevents row editing.
select_only.value: esta conexión solo permite instrucciones SELECT

select_only_blocked.value: Permiso denegado: esta conexión solo permite instrucciones SELECT
select_only_blocked.location: Results grid → Row editing → Save or delete row: error when the connection's SELECT-only policy refuses a row insert, update, or delete.

auto_rollback_blocked.value: Permiso denegado: esta conexión revierte automáticamente los cambios de datos; las ediciones de filas no se conservarían
auto_rollback_blocked.location: Results grid → Row editing → Save or delete row: error when the connection's automatic-rollback policy refuses a row insert, update, or delete because the change would be undone.

value_count_mismatch.value: El número de valores de la fila no coincide con su número de columnas
value_count_mismatch.location: Results grid → Row editing → Open row editor: internal error when the clicked row has a different number of values than the result has columns.

update_without_key.value: La actualización no tiene columnas clave para identificar la fila
update_without_key.location: Results grid → Row editing → Save changes: error when an update request reaches the service without any primary-key columns to locate the row.

delete_without_key.value: La eliminación no tiene columnas clave para identificar la fila
delete_without_key.location: Results grid → Row editing → Delete row: error when a delete request reaches the service without any primary-key columns to locate the row.

fk_search_without_key.value: Para buscar en la tabla referenciada se necesita al menos una columna clave
fk_search_without_key.location: Results grid → Row editing → Foreign-key value picker: error when searching the referenced table is requested without any key column to search by.

fetched_row_missing_column.value: Error al ejecutar la consulta: a la fila obtenida le falta la columna {column_name}
fetched_row_missing_column.location: Results grid → Row editing → Open row editor: error when the current row read back from the table lacks one of its columns; {column_name} is the quoted column name.

key_matched_many_rows.value: Error al ejecutar la consulta: la clave coincidió con {count} filas; no se continúa
key_matched_many_rows.location: Results grid → Row editing → Open row editor: error when the row's primary-key values match more than one row, so editing stops to avoid changing the wrong rows; {count} is the number of matching rows.

update_not_refetched.value: Error al ejecutar la consulta: la actualización se realizó, pero la fila no se pudo volver a leer
update_not_refetched.location: Results grid → Row editing → Save changes: error when the update was applied but reading the updated row back from the table failed.

update_rolled_back.value: Error al ejecutar la consulta: la actualización habría cambiado {count} filas, así que se revirtió (los metadatos de la clave son incoherentes)
update_rolled_back.location: Results grid → Row editing → Save changes: error when the update would have affected more than one row and was rolled back; {count} is the number of rows it would have changed.

delete_rolled_back.value: Error al ejecutar la consulta: la eliminación habría quitado {count} filas, así que se revirtió (los metadatos de la clave son incoherentes)
delete_rolled_back.location: Results grid → Row editing → Delete row: error when the delete would have removed more than one row and was rolled back; {count} is the number of rows it would have removed.

insert_returned_rows.value: Error al ejecutar la consulta: la inserción devolvió {count} filas; se esperaba exactamente 1
insert_returned_rows.location: Results grid → Row editing → Insert row: error when the insert's returned-row result (RETURNING or OUTPUT) does not contain exactly one new row; {count} is how many rows came back.

insert_affected_rows.value: Error al ejecutar la consulta: la inserción afectó a {count} filas; se esperaba exactamente 1
insert_affected_rows.location: Results grid → Row editing → Insert row: error on MySQL-family and Oracle connections when the insert's affected-row count is not exactly one; {count} is the reported count.

oracle_insert_without_rowid.value: Error al ejecutar la consulta: la inserción se realizó, pero Oracle no devolvió ningún ROWID para la fila nueva
oracle_insert_without_rowid.location: Results grid → Row editing → Insert row on Oracle Database: error when the insert ran but the server did not return the new row's ROWID, so it cannot be shown.

metadata_result_sets.value: Error al ejecutar la consulta: la consulta de metadatos de la tabla devolvió {count} conjuntos de resultados; se esperaban 6
metadata_result_sets.location: Results grid → Row editing → Open row editor on SQL Server: error when the table-metadata batch returns an unexpected number of result sets; {count} is how many came back.

unsupported_engine.value: La edición de filas no es compatible con {engine_name} (conexiones {connection_kind})
unsupported_engine.location: Results grid → Row editing → Open row editor: error when the connection's engine has no row-editing support; {engine_name} is the engine, e.g. IBM Db2, and {connection_kind} the internal protocol name that stays untranslated.

libsql_no_transaction.value: Error al ejecutar la consulta: se solicitó {statement}, pero no hay ninguna transacción de libSQL abierta
libsql_no_transaction.location: Results grid → Row editing → Save changes on libSQL / Turso: error when finishing the edit transaction finds none open; {statement} is the SQL keyword COMMIT or ROLLBACK and stays untranslated.

libsql_transaction_open.value: Error al ejecutar la consulta: ya hay una transacción de libSQL abierta
libsql_transaction_open.location: Results grid → Row editing → Save changes on libSQL / Turso: error when the edit tries to begin a transaction while another one is still open on the same connection.

later_result_set.location: Results grid → Row editing → Open row editor: reason a row cannot be edited when it comes from the second or a later result set of a multi-statement batch, whose source table cannot be traced.
later_result_set.value: solo se puede editar el primer conjunto de resultados de un lote (el origen de los conjuntos posteriores no está disponible)

later_result_set_template.location: Results grid → Row editing → Open row editor: reason a row cannot seed a new-row (insert or duplicate) form when it comes from the second or a later result set of a batch.
later_result_set_template.value: solo el primer conjunto de resultados de un lote puede usarse como plantilla de inserción

provenance_failed.location: Results grid → Row editing → Open row editor: reason a row cannot be edited when the database could not describe which table the query's columns come from; {error_message} is the database's own error text.
provenance_failed.value: no se pudo determinar el origen de la instrucción: {error_message}

result_shape_unknown.location: Results grid → Row editing → Open row editor: reason a row cannot be edited when the database could not report the columns the query returns.
result_shape_unknown.value: no se pudo determinar la forma del resultado de la instrucción

column_count_mismatch.location: Results grid → Row editing → Open row editor: reason a row cannot be edited when the database describes a different number of columns than the grid shows; {described_count} is the described column count and {grid_count} the grid's column count.
column_count_mismatch.value: el resultado descrito tiene {described_count} columnas, pero la cuadrícula tiene {grid_count}; no se puede confiar en el origen

multiple_tables.location: Results grid → Row editing → Open row editor: reason a row cannot be edited when its columns come from two different tables, as in a join; {first_table} and {second_table} are the quoted table names.
multiple_tables.value: el resultado proviene de más de una tabla ({first_table} y {second_table}); los resultados combinados son de solo lectura

joined_tables.location: Results grid → Row editing → Open row editor: reason an Oracle row cannot be edited when the query reads from more than one table, as in a join.
joined_tables.value: el resultado proviene de más de una tabla; los resultados combinados son de solo lectura

no_source_column.location: Results grid → Row editing → Open row editor: reason a row cannot be edited when none of its columns comes directly from a table column (only expressions or computed values).
no_source_column.value: ninguna columna de este resultado corresponde a una columna de tabla; el resultado es de solo lectura

no_primary_key.location: Results grid → Row editing → Open row editor: reason a row cannot be edited when its source table has no primary key; {table_name} is the quoted table name.
no_primary_key.value: {table_name} no tiene clave principal; las filas no se pueden identificar de forma segura

key_column_not_projected.location: Results grid → Row editing → Open row editor: reason a row cannot be edited when a primary-key column is missing from the query's columns; {column_name} is the quoted key column name.
key_column_not_projected.value: la columna clave {column_name} no forma parte de este resultado; inclúyela en el SELECT para editar filas

key_column_null.location: Results grid → Row editing → Open row editor: reason a row cannot be edited when one of its primary-key values is NULL; {column_name} is the quoted key column name.
key_column_null.value: la columna clave {column_name} es NULL en esta fila; no se puede identificar la fila

row_not_found.location: Results grid → Row editing → Open row editor: reason a row cannot be edited when it no longer exists in the table, for example because someone deleted it after the query ran.
row_not_found.value: no se encontró la fila; puede que se haya eliminado después de ejecutar la consulta

key_matched_many_rows.location: Results grid → Row editing → Open row editor: reason a row cannot be edited when its primary-key values match more than one table row; {count} is the number of matching rows.
key_matched_many_rows.value: la clave coincidió con {count} filas; los metadatos de la clave principal son incoherentes

not_base_table.location: Results grid → Row editing → Open row editor: reason a row cannot be edited when its source is a view or another object that is not a base table; {table_name} is the quoted object name.
not_base_table.value: {table_name} no es una tabla base (las vistas son de solo lectura en el editor de filas)

table_not_found.location: Results grid → Row editing → Open row editor: reason a row cannot be edited when its source table no longer exists in the current database; {table_name} is the quoted table name.
table_not_found.value: no se encontró {table_name} en esta base de datos

empty_statement.location: Results grid → Row editing → Open row editor: reason a row cannot be edited when the query text behind the grid is empty or only comments.

several_statements.location: Results grid → Row editing → Open row editor: reason a row cannot be edited when the query tab that produced the grid holds more than one statement.
several_statements.value: solo se puede editar una única instrucción SELECT; la pestaña contiene varias instrucciones

batch_read_only.location: Results grid → Row editing → Open row editor: reason an Oracle row cannot be edited when the query text is a batch of several statements.
batch_read_only.value: solo se puede editar una única instrucción SELECT (los lotes son de solo lectura)

with_query_read_only.location: Results grid → Row editing → Open row editor: reason an Oracle row cannot be edited when the query uses a WITH clause (common table expression).
with_query_read_only.value: los resultados de una consulta WITH son de solo lectura

not_select.location: Results grid → Row editing → Open row editor: reason an Oracle row cannot be edited when the statement behind the grid is not a SELECT.
not_select.value: solo se pueden editar las filas de una instrucción SELECT

derived_source.location: Results grid → Row editing → Open row editor: reason an Oracle row cannot be edited when the query reads from a derived table, subquery, table function, or PIVOT instead of a table.
derived_source.value: los resultados basados en una tabla derivada, una subconsulta, una función de tabla o un PIVOT son de solo lectura

no_source_table.location: Results grid → Row editing → Open row editor: reason an Oracle row cannot be edited when the query does not read from any table.
no_source_table.value: la instrucción no lee de ninguna tabla

dual_has_no_rows.location: Results grid → Row editing → Open row editor: reason an Oracle row cannot be edited when the query selects from the DUAL pseudo-table.
dual_has_no_rows.value: DUAL no tiene filas que editar

synonym_unresolved.location: Results grid → Row editing → Open row editor: reason an Oracle row cannot be edited when the query reads through a synonym whose target object cannot be found; {synonym_name} is the quoted synonym name.
synonym_unresolved.value: {synonym_name} es un sinónimo cuyo destino no se pudo resolver

synonym_not_base_table.location: Results grid → Row editing → Open row editor: reason an Oracle row cannot be edited when the query reads through a synonym that points at a view or other non-table object; {synonym_name} is the quoted synonym name.
synonym_not_base_table.value: {synonym_name} es un sinónimo de algo que no es una tabla base (las vistas son de solo lectura en el editor de filas)

named.location: Query Safety → Batch Lead Violation: guidance shown when DDL follows a named statement type in the same batch.
named.value: {ddl} debe ser la primera instrucción de su lote, pero una instrucción {preceding_statement} se ejecuta antes en el mismo lote; SQL Server lo rechaza con el error 111. Coloca GO en su propia línea antes de {ddl} para que comience un lote nuevo.

named_rollback.location: Query Safety → Batch Lead Violation with Rollback: guidance naming the preceding statement and explaining how to bypass the rollback wrapper.
named_rollback.value: {ddl} debe ser la primera instrucción de su lote, pero una instrucción {preceding_statement} se ejecuta antes en el mismo lote; SQL Server lo rechaza con el error 111. Coloca GO en su propia línea antes de {ddl} para que comience un lote nuevo. Esta conexión también envuelve cada ejecución en una transacción revertida, lo que agrega su propio BEGIN TRANSACTION inicial; ejecuta «Ejecutar sin envoltura de reversión» para eliminar esa envoltura en esta ejecución.

unnamed.location: Query Safety → Batch Lead Violation: guidance shown when DDL follows an unnamed statement in the same batch.
unnamed.value: {ddl} debe ser la primera instrucción de su lote, pero otra instrucción se ejecuta antes en el mismo lote; SQL Server lo rechaza con el error 111. Coloca GO en su propia línea antes de {ddl} para que comience un lote nuevo.

unnamed_rollback.location: Query Safety → Batch Lead Violation with Rollback: guidance for an unnamed preceding statement and the rollback-wrapper bypass.
unnamed_rollback.value: {ddl} debe ser la primera instrucción de su lote, pero otra instrucción se ejecuta antes en el mismo lote; SQL Server lo rechaza con el error 111. Coloca GO en su propia línea antes de {ddl} para que comience un lote nuevo. Esta conexión también envuelve cada ejecución en una transacción revertida, lo que agrega su propio BEGIN TRANSACTION inicial; ejecuta «Ejecutar sin envoltura de reversión» para eliminar esa envoltura en esta ejecución.

ambiguous.location: Query Safety → Classification Preview: refusal shown when the statement cannot be classified safely; preserve the parser detail.
ambiguous.value: la instrucción no se puede clasificar con seguridad: {detail} (según la lectura de {reading})

cte_no_select.location: Query Safety → Classification Preview: refusal shown when a CTE contains no SELECT.
cte_no_select.value: la instrucción CTE no contiene SELECT (según la lectura de {reading})

empty.location: Query Safety → SELECT-Only Preview: refusal shown for an empty query.

mutating_keyword.location: Query Safety → Classification Preview: refusal naming the mutating keyword.
mutating_keyword.value: la instrucción contiene la palabra clave mutadora {keyword} (según la lectura de {reading})

not_select.location: Query Safety → Classification Preview: refusal shown when a statement cannot be classified as SELECT.
not_select.value: la instrucción no se pudo clasificar como SELECT (según la lectura de {reading})

not_select_start.location: Query Safety → Classification Preview: refusal naming the statement's non-SELECT leading keyword.
not_select_start.value: la instrucción comienza con {keyword}, no con SELECT (según la lectura de {reading})

redis_write.location: Query Safety → Redis SELECT-Only Preview: refusal naming the line and non-read-only command.
redis_write.value: línea {line}: {command_name} no es un comando de solo lectura

server_artifact.location: Query Safety → Classification Preview: refusal naming the dangerous server-side artifact.
server_artifact.value: la instrucción usa el artefacto del servidor {artifact} (según la lectura de {reading})

session_set.location: Query Safety → Classification Preview: refusal shown when SET changes more than session reporting and planning.
session_set.value: la instrucción SET cambia más que las opciones de informes y planificación de esta sesión (según la lectura de {reading})

database_refusal.location: AI Query Safety → Database Read-Only Refusal: message shown when the database rejects a write under read-only enforcement; preserve the raw server detail.
database_refusal.value: bloqueado: las consultas de IA se ejecutan en modo de solo lectura en esta conexión y la base de datos rechazó una escritura ({detail})

dynamic_batch.location: AI Query Safety → Dynamic Batch Refusal: message shown when a procedure or dynamic batch may have effects outside rollback.
dynamic_batch.value: bloqueado: las consultas de IA se ejecutan en modo de solo lectura; {statement_name} no está permitido porque un procedimiento o lote dinámico puede tener efectos que una reversión no puede deshacer

extended_procedure.location: AI Query Safety → Extended Procedure Refusal: message shown when an extended procedure runs outside transaction control.
extended_procedure.value: bloqueado: las consultas de IA se ejecutan en modo de solo lectura; {statement_name} no está permitido porque los procedimientos extendidos se ejecutan fuera de la transacción

external_effect.location: AI Query Safety → External Effect Refusal: message shown when a statement reaches another server or the file system.
external_effect.value: bloqueado: las consultas de IA se ejecutan en modo de solo lectura; {statement_name} no está permitido porque accede a otro servidor o al sistema de archivos fuera de la transacción

other.location: AI Query Safety → General Read-Only Refusal: fallback message for a statement rejected by the read-only screen.
other.value: bloqueado: las consultas de IA se ejecutan en modo de solo lectura; {statement_name} no está permitido porque {reason}

procedure_allowlist.location: AI Query Safety → System Procedure Refusal: message shown when a system procedure is outside the read-only allowlist.
procedure_allowlist.value: bloqueado: las consultas de IA se ejecutan en modo de solo lectura; {statement_name} no está permitido porque solo una pequeña lista de procedimientos del sistema de solo lectura puede ejecutarse

redis_write.location: AI Query Safety → Redis Write Refusal: message shown when an AI query contains a Redis write command.
redis_write.value: bloqueado: las consultas de IA se ejecutan en modo de solo lectura; {statement_name} no está permitido porque escribe o cambia el servidor (solo se permiten comandos Redis de solo lectura)

side_effect_function.location: AI Query Safety → Side-Effect Function Refusal: message shown when a function's effects survive a read-only transaction.
side_effect_function.value: bloqueado: las consultas de IA se ejecutan en modo de solo lectura; {statement_name} no está permitido porque su efecto no se deshace con una transacción de solo lectura

fifteen_minutes.location: Production Unlock → Duration Picker: option allowing writes for fifteen minutes.

five_minutes.location: Production Unlock → Duration Picker: option allowing writes for five minutes.

one_minute.location: Production Unlock → Duration Picker: option allowing writes for one minute.

changed.location: Schema Compare → Difference Note: explanation shown when normalized definitions differ.

cross_engine.location: Schema Compare → Difference Note: explanation shown when definitions come from different database engines.
cross_engine.value: Las definiciones usan dialectos de motores diferentes; la traducción puede tener pérdidas y requiere revisión manual.

provider_unsupported.location: File menu → Import From Other Tools → DBeaver import preview: lowercase clause inserted as {reason} after “Skipped {name}:” when the DBeaver connection's provider is one SQLLY cannot open; {provider} is DBeaver's provider id.

sentinel_master_missing.location: File menu → Import From Other Tools → Redis Insight import result: lowercase clause inserted as {reason} after “Skipped {name}:” when a Sentinel database in the export has no master group name.
sentinel_master_missing.value: una base de datos de Sentinel sin nombre de grupo maestro

sqlite_path_missing.location: File menu → Import From Other Tools → import preview (TablePlus, Navicat, DBeaver): lowercase clause inserted as {reason} after “Skipped {name}:” when a SQLite connection has no database file path.
sqlite_path_missing.value: a la conexión de SQLite le falta la ruta de la base de datos

url_empty.location: File menu → Import From Other Tools → DBeaver import preview: lowercase clause inserted as {reason} after “Skipped {name}:” when a URL-configured DBeaver connection’s URL is present but empty.
url_empty.value: la URL de conexión está vacía

url_engine_unsupported.location: File menu → Import From Other Tools → DBeaver import preview: lowercase clause inserted as {reason} after “Skipped {name}:” when a URL-configured DBeaver connection’s URL names a database engine SQLLY cannot open; {engine_name} is that engine as written in the URL.
url_engine_unsupported.value: la URL de conexión indica un motor no compatible: {engine_name}

url_invalid_port.location: File menu → Import From Other Tools → DBeaver import preview: lowercase clause inserted as {reason} after “Skipped {name}:” when a URL-configured DBeaver connection’s URL has a port that is not a valid number; {port} is the port text as written.
url_invalid_port.value: la URL de conexión tiene un puerto no válido: {port}

url_missing.location: File menu → Import From Other Tools → DBeaver import preview: lowercase clause inserted as {reason} after “Skipped {name}:” when a URL-configured DBeaver connection has no URL.
url_missing.value: a la configuración por URL le falta la URL

url_unparsed.location: File menu → Import From Other Tools → DBeaver import preview: lowercase clause inserted as {reason} after “Skipped {name}:” when a URL-configured DBeaver connection’s URL cannot be parsed as a URL; {detail} is the URL parser’s own untranslated explanation, e.g. “empty host”.
url_unparsed.value: no se pudo analizar la URL: {detail}

url_unrecognized.location: File menu → Import From Other Tools → DBeaver import preview: lowercase clause inserted as {reason} after “Skipped {name}:” when a URL-configured DBeaver connection’s URL is not in any connection-string format SQLLY recognizes.
url_unrecognized.value: no se reconoce el formato de la URL de conexión

clickhouse_upsert.location: Data Transfer → ClickHouse Upsert: capability guidance shown when upsert is requested for ClickHouse.
clickhouse_upsert.value: {table_name}: ClickHouse no tiene upsert (las filas se agregan y los duplicados no se combinan); usa Agregar o Truncar y luego insertar

table_failed.location: Data Transfer → Table Error: wrapper shown when a table cannot be transferred; preserve the raw transfer detail.

upsert_no_primary_key.location: Data Transfer → Upsert Validation: message shown when upsert is requested without a primary key.
upsert_no_primary_key.value: {table_name} no tiene clave primaria; el modo upsert no puede ejecutarse

encoded.location: Data Transfer → Type Mapping Warnings: notice showing the storage encoding selected for a column.

narrowed.location: Data Transfer → Type Mapping Warnings: notice shown when a target type is narrowed.

unknown.location: Data Transfer → Type Mapping Warnings: notice shown when an unknown source type is stored as text.

widened.location: Data Transfer → Type Mapping Warnings: notice shown when a target type is widened.

clickhouse_no_primary_key.location: Data Transfer → ClickHouse Create Table Warnings: notice shown when a table has no primary key for MergeTree ordering.
clickhouse_no_primary_key.value: {table_name}: sin clave primaria; se crea como MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() (sin clave de ordenación)

identity_not_recreated.location: Data Transfer → Create Table Warnings: notice shown when identity or auto-increment behavior is omitted.
identity_not_recreated.value: la identidad o el autoincremento no se recrea en el destino

non_finite_null.location: Data Transfer → Value Conversion Warnings: notice shown when non-finite floating-point values are written as NULL.
non_finite_null.value: los valores de punto flotante no finitos se enviaron como NULL

terminal_password_notice.location: Settings → Workspace → Advanced → Database tools: macOS-only checkbox label; when checked, SQLLY explains the temporary password launcher file before Open in Terminal starts a database command-line client.
terminal_password_notice.value: Explicar el archivo de contraseña temporal antes de abrir en Terminal

app_store_kubectl_notice.location: Settings → Workspace → Advanced → Kubernetes: edition notice shown in the Mac App Store edition instead of the kubectl path field, explaining Kubernetes discovery is unavailable there.
app_store_kubectl_notice.value: La detección de Kubernetes usa kubectl, que la edición de Mac App Store no puede iniciar.

not_found.location: Settings → Workspace → Advanced → Database tools: status line under a tool path field (pg_dump, psql, mysql, sqlcmd, …) when that command-line tool could not be located.

file_too_large.location: Send Feedback and Improve IntelliSense reports → Attached settings snapshot: reason recorded for a settings file left out because it is too big; {bytes} is its size in bytes. Lowercase fragment.
file_too_large.value: demasiado grande para el informe ({bytes} bytes)

invalid_json.location: Send Feedback and Improve IntelliSense reports → Attached settings snapshot: reason recorded for a settings file left out because its contents are not valid JSON. Lowercase fragment.

advanced.location: Settings → Workspace → Advanced: main heading at the top of the Advanced pane, which holds Kubernetes, database tool paths, and the Clear all data reset.

logging.location: Settings → Debug → Logging: main heading at the top of the Logging pane for Server Explorer diagnostic logging.

query_resume.location: Settings → Workspace → Query resume: main heading at the top of the Query resume pane, which controls whether query tabs restore their saved state after restart.

log_level_explained.location: Settings → Debug → Logging → Log level: help text under the Log level dropdown describing what the Off, Errors only, and Verbose levels each record.
log_level_explained.value: Desactivado no recopila nada. Solo errores registra los fallos y las excepciones internas. Detallado registra cada paso e incluye mediciones de tiempo. No se recopila nada a menos que se seleccione un nivel superior a Desactivado.

per_query_toggle.location: Settings → Workspace → Query resume → Per query: help text explaining the state-saving toggle on each query’s toolbar, which follows the global default unless clicked to override for that query.
per_query_toggle.value: Cada consulta tiene un control en su barra de herramientas para guardar el estado. Refleja el valor predeterminado global; haz clic para cambiarlo por consulta y la elección se recuerda entre sesiones.

per_query_tracked_state.location: Settings → Workspace → Query resume → Per query: help text listing every piece of state a query tab remembers (result layout, diff mode, AI autocomplete, server, database, AI summaries).
per_query_tracked_state.value: Para cada consulta, la reanudación conserva: el diseño de resultados (apilado o una pestaña por conjunto), el modo de diferencias, el autocompletado de IA (FIM), el servidor, la base de datos, el resumen breve de IA y el resumen detallado de IA

reconnect_behavior.location: Settings → Workspace → Query resume → Reconnect: help text explaining that a restored query shows its last server and database but stays disconnected until the next run asks for confirmation.
reconnect_behavior.value: Cuando una consulta se restaura, los desplegables de servidor y base de datos muestran los últimos valores usados, pero permanecen deshabilitados y la consulta no se conecta. La siguiente ejecución pide confirmación antes de activar esa conexión.

terminal_password_script.location: Settings → Workspace → Advanced → Database tools: macOS-only help text under the password-notice checkbox, explaining how Open in Terminal hands a saved password to the client via a self-deleting script.
terminal_password_script.value: En macOS, Abrir en Terminal pasa la contraseña guardada al cliente mediante un script de inicio que se elimina mientras se ejecuta.

kubectl_path.location: Settings → Workspace → Advanced → Kubernetes: label beside the text field where the user can enter a custom path to the kubectl program used for Kubernetes discovery.

advanced.location: Settings → Workspace → Advanced: introductory text under the pane heading warning that destructive maintenance such as Clear all data lives here and cannot be undone.
advanced.value: El mantenimiento destructivo está aquí para mantenerlo fuera de los menús cotidianos. Borrar todos los datos no se puede deshacer.

logging.location: Settings → Debug → Logging: introductory text under the pane heading explaining what Server Explorer diagnostic logging records and how to share the log file.
logging.value: Registro de diagnóstico paso a paso para el Explorador de servidores. Actívalo para capturar cada expansión, carga y error cuando el árbol de la base de datos falle; después, muestra el archivo de registro para compartirlo.

query_resume.location: Settings → Workspace → Query resume: introductory text under the pane heading explaining which saved state queries can restore automatically.
query_resume.value: Elige qué consultas restauran automáticamente su estado guardado: diseño de resultados apilado o por pestañas, modo de diferencias, autocompletado de IA y último servidor y base de datos utilizados.

tool_path_overrides.location: Settings → Workspace → Advanced → Database tools: introductory text above the list of command-line tool path fields, explaining they override tools not found on PATH.
tool_path_overrides.value: Sobrescribe las rutas de pg_dump, pg_restore, mysqldump y mysql cuando no estén en PATH.

tools_bundled_app_store.location: Settings → Workspace → Advanced → Database tools: text shown only in the Mac App Store edition, in place of the tool path fields, stating these tools are bundled with the app.
tools_bundled_app_store.value: pg_dump, pg_restore, psql, mysqldump y mysql están incluidos en la edición de Mac App Store.

detect_again.location: Settings → Workspace → Advanced → Kubernetes: small button under the kubectl path field that searches for kubectl again and refreshes the found/not-found status line.

re_scan.location: Settings → Workspace → Advanced → Database tools: small button below the tool path fields that searches the system again for all database command-line tools and refreshes their status lines.

log_level.location: Settings → Debug → Logging → Log level: label to the left of the dropdown that chooses the diagnostic logging level (Off, Errors only, Verbose).

clear_all_data.location: Settings → Workspace → Advanced → Reset: red button that asks for confirmation and then erases all of SQLLY’s local data (connections, settings, history); cannot be undone.

open_log_file.location: Settings → Debug → Logging → Log location: button that opens the diagnostic log file in the system’s default viewer.

reveal_finder.location: Settings → Debug → Logging → Log location: button that shows the diagnostic log file selected in a macOS Finder window.

found.location: Settings → Workspace → Advanced → Kubernetes: status line under the kubectl path field when kubectl was located; {value} is the full path to the kubectl program.

found_at.location: Settings → Workspace → Advanced → Database tools: status line under a tool path field when the tool was located but its version is unknown; {value} is the program’s full path.

found_ver_at.location: Settings → Workspace → Advanced → Database tools: status line under a tool path field when the tool was located; {ver} is its version number and {value} the program’s full path.

not_found_path.location: Settings → Workspace → Advanced → Kubernetes: status line under the kubectl path field when no kubectl program was found on the system PATH.

database_tools.location: Settings → Workspace → Advanced: section heading above the paths of external command-line tools (pg_dump, psql, mysql, sqlcmd, …) used for dumps, restores, and Open in Terminal.

default.location: Settings → Workspace → Query resume: section heading above the dropdown choosing which queries resume their state by default (saved files, unsaved queries, both, or manual); reads as “Default for: [choice]”.

kubernetes.location: Settings → Workspace → Advanced: section heading above the kubectl path setting used to discover databases running in Kubernetes clusters.

log_level.location: Settings → Debug → Logging: section heading above the Log level dropdown and its explanation.

log_location.location: Settings → Debug → Logging: section heading above the log file path and its Reveal in Finder and Open Log File buttons.

per_query.location: Settings → Workspace → Query resume: section heading above the help text about overriding query resume for individual queries.

reconnect.location: Settings → Workspace → Query resume: section heading above the help text explaining how a restored query reconnects to its server and database.

reset.location: Settings → Workspace → Advanced: section heading at the bottom of the pane above the red Clear all data… button.

allow_result_data_sent.location: Settings → AI → Decision model → Privacy section: checkbox label; when on, the decision model may also receive query result rows, not just questions, schema names and SQL text.

enable_decision_model.location: Settings → AI → Decision model → Enable section: checkbox label that turns the optional fast decision-model provider on or off (off by default); saved immediately.

send_reasoning_effort.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: checkbox label shown only for OpenAI-compatible profiles; when on, the chosen reasoning level is sent as the “reasoning_effort” request parameter. Keep “reasoning_effort” untranslated.

show_ai_query_summary_bar.location: Settings → AI → On device → Query summaries section: checkbox label that turns on the bar above query results showing a plain-language AI summary of the tab's SQL.
show_ai_query_summary_bar.value: Mostrar la barra de resumen de consultas con IA

use_local_agent_cli.location: Settings → AI → Coding agent CLI: checkbox label at the top of the pane; when on, the AI drawer's Agent mode runs a locally installed coding-agent CLI (Claude Code or Codex) instead of the built-in agent.
use_local_agent_cli.value: Usar una CLI de agente de programación local para el modo Agente

deepseek_reasoning.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: help text under the Reasoning dropdown, shown only for DeepSeek profiles, explaining the chosen reasoning level is ignored because the model id decides reasoning depth.
deepseek_reasoning.value: La profundidad de razonamiento se elige mediante el ID del modelo en este proveedor; se ignora el nivel seleccionado arriba.

cloud.location: Settings → AI → Cloud and AI playground: short cloud-egress badge for a remote provider.

cloud_detail.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Privacy: remote-provider egress explanation including the destination host.
cloud_detail.value: Nube: envía las solicitudes y extractos del esquema a {host}

local.location: Settings → AI → Cloud and AI playground: short local-egress badge for a provider hosted on this machine.

local_detail.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Privacy: local-provider egress explanation including the provider host.
local_detail.value: Local: {host}; las solicitudes y el esquema permanecen en este equipo

api_key_rejected.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: status error shown after Fetch models when the provider answers HTTP 401 or 403; {provider_name} is the profile name.
api_key_rejected.value: {provider_name} rechazó la clave de API. Comprueba la clave y vuelve a intentarlo.

browser_unavailable.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details (browser build): clause saying cloud AI providers are unavailable, inserted as {feature} into the browser-preview notice shown as the provider error.
browser_unavailable.value: La IA en la nube no está disponible

http_status.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: status error shown after Fetch models when the provider answers with any other failing HTTP status; {provider_name} is the profile name, {status_code} the numeric HTTP code.
http_status.value: {provider_name} devolvió HTTP {status_code}. Comprueba el estado del proveedor y vuelve a intentarlo.

invalid_response.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: status error shown after Fetch models when the provider's model list cannot be read or its endpoint URL is unusable; saved models are left unchanged. {provider_name} is the profile name.
invalid_response.value: {provider_name} devolvió una lista de modelos inesperada. SQLLY no actualizó los modelos guardados.

network.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: status error shown after Fetch models or Test latency when the provider's server cannot be reached at all (no connection, DNS failure, timeout).
network.value: No se pudo contactar con el proveedor de modelos. Comprueba tu conexión a internet y vuelve a intentarlo.

rate_limited.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: status error shown after Fetch models when the provider answers HTTP 429 (too many requests); {provider_name} is the profile name.
rate_limited.value: {provider_name} está limitando la frecuencia de las solicitudes. Espera un momento y vuelve a intentarlo.

openai_compatible_reasoning.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: help text under the Reasoning dropdown, shown only for OpenAI-compatible profiles, saying the level is sent only while the “Send reasoning_effort” checkbox is on.
openai_compatible_reasoning.value: Se envía como reasoning_effort solo cuando la casilla está activada.

app_store_unavailable.location: Settings → AI → Coding agent CLI: notice that replaces the whole pane in the Mac App Store edition, explaining that sandboxing blocks launching local CLI tools while Agent mode still works with cloud or Ollama.
app_store_unavailable.value: La edición de Mac App Store no puede iniciar herramientas de línea de comandos de agentes de programación locales. El modo Agente sigue funcionando con un proveedor de IA en la nube o con un servidor Ollama local.

browser_unavailable_health.location: Settings → AI → Coding agent CLI → Health check (browser build): clause inserted as {feature} into the browser-preview notice shown as the failed health-check detail.
browser_unavailable_health.value: Las CLI locales de agentes de programación no están disponibles

browser_unavailable_status.location: Settings → AI → Coding agent CLI → Detect (browser build): clause inserted as {feature} into the browser-preview notice shown in the pane's status line after detection is attempted.
browser_unavailable_status.value: Las CLI locales de agentes de programación no están disponibles

invalid_environment_on_parse.location: Settings → AI → Coding agent CLI → Extra environment: error produced when SQLLY reads the saved extra environment to start an Agent-mode run and finds a line without “=”; {line} is the offending line.
invalid_environment_on_parse.value: Línea de entorno no válida durante el análisis: `{line}`.

invalid_environment_on_save.location: Settings → AI → Coding agent CLI → Extra environment: error produced when the edited extra environment text is stored and a line has no “=” (KEY=VALUE expected); {line} is the offending line.
invalid_environment_on_save.value: Línea de entorno no válida al guardar: `{line}`.

invalid_stored_environment.location: Settings → AI → Coding agent CLI: status error shown after pressing Save when the previously stored extra environment contains a line without “=”; {line} is the offending line.
invalid_stored_environment.value: Línea de entorno no válida en la configuración guardada: `{line}`.

executable_not_found.location: Settings → AI → Coding agent CLI: warning notification shown when automatic executable detection finds no CLI on PATH.
executable_not_found.value: No se encontró en PATH; introduce la ruta manualmente

check.location: Settings → AI → On device → Local AI runtime: Check button that tests the local runtime connection.

check_2.location: Settings → AI → Decision model → Connection: Check button that tests the decision-model connection.

decision_model_unavailable.location: Settings → AI → Decision model → Connection: feature name inserted into the browser-preview “unavailable” message shown when Test is pressed in the browser build, where no decision-model client exists.
decision_model_unavailable.value: El modelo de decisión no está disponible

fetch_models.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: button below the Model field that downloads the provider's list of available models into the model dropdown.

fetching.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: label the Fetch models button shows while the provider's model list is being downloaded.

local_runtime.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → App AI backend: first option in the backend dropdown, meaning Ask, Generate and schema cards keep using the local Ollama runtime instead of a cloud profile.

saved_to_your_keychain.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Provider profile → API key: status shown after saving the provider key in the OS keyring.

saved_to_your_keychain_2.location: Settings → AI → Decision model → API key: status shown after saving the decision-model key in the OS keyring.

test.location: Settings → AI → Decision model → Connection section: button that sends one sample yes/no question to the decision model and reports the round-trip time or error.

test_latency.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: button beside Fetch models that times a request to the selected provider and shows the result in milliseconds.

testing.location: Settings → AI → On device → Local AI runtime: status shown while testing the local runtime connection.

testing_2.location: Settings → AI → Decision model → Connection: status shown while testing the decision-model connection.

auto_match_model.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Prompt format: option in the Format dropdown that automatically uses the prompt format matching the selected autocomplete model.

automatically_as_type.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Trigger: option in the Trigger dropdown that requests inline completions automatically after typing pauses.

browser_unavailable.location: Query editor → AI inline autocomplete (browser build): clause saying fill-in-the-middle AI completion is unavailable, inserted as {feature} into the browser-preview notice reported as the completion error.
browser_unavailable.value: El autocompletado con IA no está disponible

custom_tokens_pattern.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Prompt format: option in the Format dropdown for using the user's own fill-in-the-middle tokens written in the pattern template.

only_i_press_key.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Trigger: option in the Trigger dropdown that requests inline completions only when the user presses the trigger shortcut.

enable_autocomplete.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Enable section: checkbox label that turns AI inline (fill-in-the-middle) autocomplete in the SQL editor on or off.

enable_new_queries_by_default.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Enable section: checkbox label that makes AI inline autocomplete start switched on in every newly opened query tab.
enable_new_queries_by_default.value: Activar por defecto para nuevas consultas

stop_newline.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Generation section: checkbox label; when on, an inline suggestion stops at the end of the current line instead of spanning several lines.

trim_leading_whitespace.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Generation section: checkbox label; when on, spaces and tabs at the start of an inline suggestion are removed before it is shown.

autocomplete_fim.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM): title at the top of the pane for AI inline autocomplete settings; FIM means fill-in-the-middle and can stay as an abbreviation.

coding_agent_cli.location: Settings → AI → Coding agent CLI: pane title shown in the Mac App Store edition, above the notice that local coding-agent CLIs cannot be launched.

coding_agent_cli_2.location: Settings → AI → Coding agent CLI: pane title shown in editions that can launch local programs, above the intro and the CLI agent settings.

decision_model.location: Settings → AI → Decision model: title at the top of the pane for the optional fast decision-model provider used for quick typed judgments.

device.location: Settings → AI → On device: title at the top of the pane for on-device AI (query summaries, Agent mode limits and the local Ollama runtime).

providers.location: Settings → AI → Cloud: title at the top of the pane that lists cloud and self-hosted AI provider profiles.

agent_read_only_safeguards.location: Settings → AI → On device → Agent mode section: help text under Max agent turns explaining the two safeguards that keep the AI agent's database lookups read-only, with per-engine caveats.
agent_read_only_safeguards.value: Las consultas del agente son de solo lectura por dos motivos: SQLLY comprueba que cada una sea un SELECT y la base de datos las ejecuta en una transacción de solo lectura que siempre se revierte (modo de solo consulta en SQLite; en SQL Server, una transacción revertida más un filtro de instrucciones, ya que no tiene transacciones de solo lectura).

app_backend_help.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → App AI backend section: help text above the backend dropdown explaining what using a profile for Ask, Generate and schema cards changes and what data leaves the machine.
app_backend_help.value: Dirige Preguntar, Generar y la caché de tarjetas de esquema a través del modelo del perfil seleccionado en lugar del entorno local. Esta ruta envía fuera del equipo tu solicitud, extractos del esquema y una lista breve de nombres de herramientas MCP cuando el perfil está alojado en la nube; los resúmenes de consultas, la revisión con IA y el autocompletado en línea permanecen en Ollama local. Reinicia SQLLY para aplicar el cambio.

base_url_help.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: help text under the Base URL field explaining when the URL should end in “/v1”.
base_url_help.value: Las URL compatibles con OpenAI incluyen /v1; las URL base de Anthropic y Gemini la omiten.

choose_new_profile_kind.location: Settings → AI → Cloud: prompt shown after pressing “+ Add profile”, above the dropdown of provider kinds; picking one creates the new profile. Ends with a colon.
choose_new_profile_kind.value: Elige un tipo de proveedor para el nuevo perfil:

cloud_key_not_saved.location: Settings → AI → Cloud → Profile details: help text under the API key field, shown while the selected profile has no key stored in the Keychain yet.
cloud_key_not_saved.value: Aún no se ha guardado: introduce una clave y elige Guardar clave.

contacting_local_ai_runtime.location: Settings → AI → On device → Local AI runtime section: progress text shown under the Check button while SQLLY contacts the local Ollama runtime.
contacting_local_ai_runtime.value: Contactando con el entorno de IA local…

drawer_tool_round_limit.location: Settings → AI → On device → Agent mode section: help text under the Max agent turns field; the allowed range is 5 to 100.
drawer_tool_round_limit.value: Número de rondas de herramientas de solo lectura que el cajón de IA puede ejecutar antes de detenerse (5–100).

fim_model_size_tradeoff.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Model section: help text under the autocomplete Model dropdown comparing the speed and accuracy of the two suggested models; model names stay untranslated.
fim_model_size_tradeoff.value: Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B Base es rápido; Qwen2.5-Coder-3B Base es más preciso.

format_auto_custom.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Prompt format: help text under the Format dropdown explaining the Auto and Custom options.
format_auto_custom.value: Automático elige el formato que coincide con el modelo seleccionado. Elige Personalizado para insertar tus propios tokens en el patrón.

generation_delay_help.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Trigger section: help text under the Generation delay (s) field.
generation_delay_help.value: Tiempo que debe pausarse la escritura antes de solicitar una sugerencia automática.

install_ollama_help.location: Settings → AI → On device → Local AI runtime section: help text shown under the red error after Check fails to reach the runtime, explaining how to install and start Ollama. Keep “ollama serve” untranslated.
install_ollama_help.value: Instala Ollama desde ollama.com, inícialo (abre la aplicación o ejecuta `ollama serve`) y vuelve a comprobarlo.

key_not_saved.location: Settings → AI → Decision model → API key section: help text under the API key field, shown while the decision-model key is being entered or not yet stored.
key_not_saved.value: Aún no se ha guardado: introduce una clave y elige Guardar clave.

pinned_model_help.location: Settings → AI → Decision model → Endpoint section: help text under the Model field advising not to change the pinned model id.
pinned_model_help.value: El identificador del modelo está fijado para mantener las respuestas estables; cámbialo solo cuando el proveedor documente una nueva versión.

runtime_check_help.location: Settings → AI → On device → Local AI runtime section: help text under the Check button, shown before any check runs, explaining what Check does.
runtime_check_help.value: Comprobar verifica que el entorno de ejecución sea accesible y enumera sus modelos instalados.

runtime_no_models.location: Settings → AI → On device → Local AI runtime section: help text shown after Check succeeds but the runtime has no models; keep the command untranslated.
runtime_no_models.value: Accesible, pero no hay modelos instalados. Instala uno con `ollama pull <model>` y vuelve a comprobar.

shortcuts_help.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Shortcuts section: help text pointing to the Keyboard Shortcuts pane for the autocomplete trigger and accept keys.
shortcuts_help.value: Configura las teclas de activación y de aceptación en el panel Atajos de teclado.

suffix_budget_help.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Generation section: help text under the Suffix budget (0–1) field.
suffix_budget_help.value: Proporción de la ventana de contexto reservada para el texto situado después del cursor.

summary_bar_help.location: Settings → AI → On device → Query summaries section: help text under the “Show the AI query summary bar” checkbox; “Editor ▸ General” names another Settings pane.
summary_bar_help.value: Resume el SQL de cada pestaña de consulta en lenguaje natural, generado en el entorno de IA local y mostrado en una barra sobre los resultados. Desactivado de forma predeterminada; también está en Editor ▸ General.

summary_model_help.location: Settings → AI → On device → Query summaries section: help text under the summary Model field.
summary_model_help.value: Deja el campo vacío para usar el modelo de resumen predeterminado de la aplicación o introduce el nombre de un modelo instalado en el entorno local (consulta la lista siguiente).

generation_delay_s.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Trigger section: label beside the number field for the pause, in seconds, before an automatic completion is requested.

max_context_tokens.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Generation section: label beside the number field for how many tokens of surrounding editor text are sent to the model.

max_new_tokens.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Generation section: label beside the number field limiting how many tokens one inline suggestion may contain.

suffix_budget_0_1.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Generation section: label beside the field for the fraction (0 to 1) of the context reserved for text after the cursor.

temperature.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Generation section: label beside the field for the sampling temperature (randomness) of inline suggestions; use the usual AI term.

autocomplete.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM): introductory paragraph under the pane title explaining that inline autocomplete runs on local Ollama and when changes apply.
autocomplete.value: El autocompletado en línea de relleno intermedio (FIM) se comunica con Ollama en este equipo: el texto del editor nunca sale de tu equipo. Modelo, formato de prompt, comportamiento de activación y parámetros de generación; los cambios se aplican al cerrar Preferencias.

coding_agent_cli.location: Settings → AI → Coding agent CLI: introductory paragraph under the pane title explaining how the local CLI is sandboxed from database credentials.
coding_agent_cli.value: Ejecuta una CLI local que se comunica con la nube del proveedor. SQLLY nunca entrega tus credenciales de base de datos a la CLI; esta solo lee y escribe mediante el servidor MCP de SQLLY, y cada escritura requiere tu confirmación.

decision_model.location: Settings → AI → Decision model: introductory paragraph under the pane title explaining what a decision model does and that it never writes SQL.
decision_model.value: Un modelo de decisión responde preguntas breves con formato cerrado —elegir una de N opciones, valorar en una escala, sí o no— en una fracción de segundo. Las funciones que necesitan una decisión rápida dentro de un bucle lo usan cuando está habilitado y, si no, recurren al backend de IA de la aplicación. No puede generar texto y nunca se usa para escribir SQL.

on_device.location: Settings → AI → On device: introductory paragraph under the pane title explaining which AI features on this page stay local.
on_device.value: Los resúmenes de consultas de esta página se comunican con el entorno local de Ollama en este equipo; ese SQL nunca sale de tu equipo. Preguntar al esquema, Generar y la caché de tarjetas de esquema siguen el backend de IA de la aplicación de la página Nube.

providers.location: Settings → AI → Cloud: introductory paragraph under the Providers title explaining what a provider profile holds and where API keys are kept.
